chunks: 10) When do we use “many“ and “few“
and when do we use “much“ and “little“?
Give me an example of each.
60.rule: When do we use “X” and “Y”, and when do we use “M” and “N”? Give me an example of each. ——并列两组近义词对比用法的when特殊疑问句，用and连接，末尾祈使句要求各举一例。
60.example: When do we use “a few“ and “few“, and when do we use “a little“ and “little“? Give me an example of each. — 何时用a few和few，何时用a little和little，各举一例

61.q: As you are not tall enough to reach the ceiling, what would you have to do if you wanted to reach it?
61.backbone: as原因状语从句 + 虚拟疑问句 + if从句
61.gloss: 个子不够高，想够到天花板该怎么办
chunks: As you are not tall enough to reach the ceiling,
what would you have to do
if you wanted to reach it?
61.rule: As 原因从句(现在时描述事实), what would you have to do if 从句(过去式虚拟)? ——as引导原因状语说明现实前提，主句用what would you have to do提问虚拟应对方式，再用if加过去式表达假设条件。
61.example: As you are not strong enough to lift the box, what would you have to do if you wanted to move it? — 力气不够搬不动箱子，想搬走它该怎么办

61.q: If you went from London to Rome, which cities would you perhaps have to go through?
61.backbone: 过去虚拟条件句 + 特殊疑问句
61.gloss: 从伦敦到罗马可能要经过哪些城市
chunks: If you went from London to Rome,
which cities would you perhaps have to go through?
61.rule: If 主语+过去式(虚拟), which N would you perhaps have to V? ——if从句表与现实不同的假设旅程，主句用which...would you perhaps have to...询问途中可能经过/需要做的事，perhaps弱化肯定语气。
61.example: If you travelled from Beijing to Paris by land, which countries would you perhaps have to pass through? — 若从北京陆路去巴黎，可能要经过哪些国家

61.q: As we have now studied about a thousand words and a lot of the grammar, can you hold a simple conversation in English?
61.backbone: as原因状语从句（现在完成时）+ 一般疑问句
61.gloss: 学了上千单词和语法后能否进行简单英语对话
chunks: As we have now studied about a thousand words and a lot of the grammar,
can you hold a simple conversation in English?
61.rule: As we have now V-ed(现在完成时)..., can you V...? ——as引导原因状语从句用现在完成时总结已达成的积累，主句用can you...询问基于此积累是否具备某能力。
61.example: As we have now learned most of the basic tenses, can you write a short story in English? — 学了大部分基本时态后，你能用英语写一篇短故事吗

62.q: Now I’m going to ask you some questions with “could“ and you answer with “would be able“, and vice versa. If you were very, very tall, could you touch the ceiling?
62.backbone: 说明性陈述句 + 过去虚拟条件疑问句
62.gloss: 说明规则后提问：若你很高，能碰到天花板吗
chunks: Now I’m going to ask you some questions with “could“
and you answer with “would be able“, and vice versa.
If you were very, very tall,
could you touch the ceiling?
62.rule: 先用陈述句说明问答规则(with X and you answer with Y, and vice versa)，再接If 主语+were(虚拟), could you V...? ——前半句交代两种说法互换的练习规则，后半句用if+were虚拟条件+could发问示范。
62.example: Now I'm going to ask you questions with “can“ and you answer with “am able to“, and vice versa. If you were a bird, could you fly across the ocean? — 现在用can提问你用am able to回答，反之亦然。若你是一只鸟，能飞越海洋吗

62.q: If you were as strong as a horse, could you lift a man above your head with only one hand?
62.backbone: 过去虚拟条件句 + 情态动词疑问句
62.gloss: 若像马一样强壮，能单手把人举过头顶吗
chunks: If you were as strong as a horse,
could you lift a man above your head
with only one hand?
62.rule: If you were as adj as N(虚拟比喻), could you V ... with only + 数量? ——if从句用as...as构成虚拟比喻条件，主句could提问该条件下的能力极限，末尾with only强调条件苛刻。
62.example: If you were as fast as a cheetah, could you run a hundred metres in five seconds? — 若你像猎豹一样快，能五秒跑完百米吗

62.q: If a factory belonged to you, do you think you would be able to make a lot of money?
62.backbone: 过去虚拟条件句 + 宾语从句嵌套疑问句
62.gloss: 若你拥有一家工厂，觉得能赚很多钱吗
chunks: If a factory belonged to you,
do you think you would be able to make a lot of money?
62.rule: If N belonged to you(虚拟), do you think you would be able to V? ——if从句用belong to的过去式表虚拟拥有关系，主句do you think嵌套宾语从句用would be able to推测假设结果。
62.example: If a restaurant belonged to you, do you think you would be able to keep it successful? — 若你拥有一家餐厅，觉得能让它经营成功吗

63.q: If there wasn’t a light in this room, would we be able to see well when it got dark?
63.backbone: 过去虚拟条件句 + when时间状语从句
63.gloss: 若房间没有灯，天黑后还能看清吗
chunks: If there wasn’t a light in this room,
would we be able to see well
when it got dark?
63.rule: If there wasn't/weren't N(虚拟), would we be able to V ... when 从句? ——if从句用there wasn't表虚拟的"不存在"，主句would we be able to提问能力，when从句补充具体时间情境。
63.example: If there weren't any street lamps outside, would people be able to walk safely when it got dark? — 若外面没有路灯，天黑后人们能安全走路吗

63.q: Which do you think is less unpleasant: the dirt of the city or the dirt of the country, of the farm etc.?
63.backbone: 特殊疑问句 + 冒号后选项说明
63.gloss: 城市的脏乱和乡村的脏乱哪个更能接受
chunks: Which do you think is less unpleasant:
the dirt of the city or the dirt of the country, of the farm etc.?
63.rule: Which do you think is less/more adj: A or B, of C etc.? ——which do you think is...后用冒号引出具体比较对象，or并列选项，etc.表示可类推的同类项。
63.example: Which do you think is less tiring: the noise of the city or the noise of the airport, of the factory etc.? — 城市的噪音和机场、工厂等的噪音相比，哪个更不累人

63.q: Do you remember if you were afraid of the dark when you were a little child?
63.backbone: 一般疑问句嵌套宾语从句 + when时间状语从句
chunks: Do you remember
if you were afraid of the dark
when you were a little child?
63.rule: Do you remember if 主语+过去式... when 从句? ——一般疑问句用remember后接if引导的宾语从句(询问是否记得某状态)，再用when从句限定该状态发生的时间段。
63.example: Do you remember if you were scared of dogs when you were very young? — 你记得小时候怕狗吗

64.q: When office workers are too busy to leave their desks for lunch, do they often just have a quick sandwich?
64.backbone: when时间状语从句（too...to结构）+ 一般疑问句
64.gloss: 上班族忙得没空吃午饭时是否只吃三明治
chunks: When office workers are too busy to leave their desks for lunch,
do they often just have a quick sandwich?
64.rule: When N are too adj to V ..., do they often just V2? ——when从句用too...to表示"太…以至于不能"的情境，主句用often just提问在该情境下的常见简化做法。
64.example: When students are too tired to finish their homework, do they often just copy a classmate's? — 学生太累写不完作业时，是否常常直接抄同学的

64.q: If a student makes a mistake in his dictation, is it usually his fault or the teacher’s fault?
64.backbone: if真实条件从句 + 选择疑问句
64.gloss: 学生听写出错通常是谁的错
chunks: If a student makes a mistake in his dictation,
is it usually his fault or the teacher’s fault?
64.rule: If N V(现在时,真实条件), is it usually A's fault or B's fault? ——if引导真实条件从句，主句用形式主语it+usually询问该情况通常该归咎于谁。
64.example: If a driver has an accident in heavy rain, is it usually his fault or the weather's fault? — 司机在大雨中出事故通常是他的错还是天气的错

64.q: If you went to the cinema this evening, which film would you see?
64.backbone: 过去虚拟条件句 + 特殊疑问句
64.gloss: 若今晚去看电影，会看哪部
chunks: If you went to the cinema this evening,
which film would you see?
64.rule: If 主语+过去式(虚拟), which N would you V? ——if从句用一般过去式表与现在事实相反的假设，主句用which...would you...询问该假设下的具体选择。
64.example: If you went shopping this weekend, which shop would you visit first? — 若这周末去购物，你会先去哪家店

65.q: If you lent something to somebody and they didn’t return it, what’d you do?
65.backbone: 混合条件句：若过去借出未还，现在怎么做
65.gloss: 如果你借东西给别人却不还，你会怎么做？
chunks: If you lent something to somebody
and they didn’t return it,
what’d you do?
65.rule: If+主语+过去式A，and+主语+过去式B（虚拟条件并列两动作），what'd+主语+动词原形？
65.example: If you borrowed a book from the library and forgot to return it, what'd you do? — 如果你从图书馆借书忘了归还，你会怎么做？

65.q: Why should you not worry if you don’t immediately understand some of the grammar in this book?
65.backbone: why疑问句 + if条件从句给理由
65.gloss: 为什么不必因暂时不懂书里的语法而担心？
chunks: Why should you not worry
if you don’t immediately understand some of the grammar in this book?
65.rule: Why should+主语+not+动词原形 if+主语+现在时从句（给出该情绪/行为不必要的条件）？
65.example: Why should you not panic if you don't immediately remember every word in this list? — 为什么不必因一时记不住单词表里的每个词而恐慌？

65.q: If you keep somebody waiting for a long time, should you apologize?
65.backbone: 条件句 + 一般疑问句（是否应该）
65.gloss: 如果让别人久等，你该道歉吗？
chunks: If you keep somebody waiting for a long time,
should you apologize?
65.rule: If+主语+现在时（真实条件）, should+主语+动词原形？——用于征询某行为是否应当。
65.example: If you make somebody angry by mistake, should you explain yourself? — 如果不小心惹恼了别人，你该解释吗？

66.q: Now I am going to give you a sentence in the active voice, and I want you to put it into the passive voice: John eats the pasta
66.backbone: 祈使说明 + and并列 + 冒号引出例句（主动转被动）
66.gloss: 给出主动语态句子，要求改成被动语态
chunks: Now I am going to give you a sentence in the active voice,
and I want you to put it into the passive voice:
John eats the pasta
66.rule: Now I am going to give you a X, and I want you to put it into Y: 冒号后给出待处理材料。
66.example: Now I am going to give you a word in the singular, and I want you to put it into the plural: child — 现在我给你一个单数名词，请把它变成复数：child

66.q: Would it be OK for a man to wear jeans and trainers if he was going to a formal dinner?
66.backbone: 虚拟条件句嵌入一般疑问句（是否合适）
66.gloss: 如果去正式晚宴，穿牛仔裤运动鞋合适吗？
chunks: Would it be OK for a man to wear jeans and trainers
if he was going to a formal dinner?
66.rule: Would it be OK for+人+to+动词原形 if+主语+was/were going to+情境（虚拟条件判断得体性）？
66.example: Would it be OK for a woman to wear shorts and sandals if she was going to a business meeting? — 如果要去商务会议，女士穿短裤凉鞋合适吗？

66.q: Were the students standing or sitting when I left the classroom at the end of the last lesson?
66.backbone: 选择疑问句 + when时间从句
66.gloss: 上节课我离开教室时，学生是站着还是坐着？
chunks: Were the students standing or sitting
when I left the classroom at the end of the last lesson?
66.rule: Were+主语+Ving A or Ving B when+主语+过去式从句（过去进行时选择疑问句，用when锚定时间点）？
66.example: Were the workers talking or working when the manager entered the office at the start of the meeting? — 会议开始经理进办公室时，工人是在聊天还是在工作？

67.q: If you wanted to go from here to Scotland, would you have to cross the sea or would you be able to go all the way by land?
67.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + or并列选择疑问句
67.gloss: 去苏格兰要跨海还是能全程走陆路？
chunks: If you wanted to go from here to Scotland,
would you have to cross the sea
or would you be able to go all the way by land?
67.rule: If+主语+过去式（虚拟条件）, would+主语+have to+V or would+主语+be able to+V？——条件后接两个并列疑问句表互斥选项。
67.example: If you wanted to send this parcel abroad, would you have to go to the post office or would you be able to do it online? — 如果要把包裹寄到国外，你得去邮局还是能网上办理？

67.q: If you want to go from one side of the road to the other, what must you do?
67.backbone: 真实条件句 + what疑问句（义务）
67.gloss: 要过马路，你必须怎么做？
chunks: If you want to go from one side of the road to the other,
what must you do?
67.rule: If+主语+现在时（真实条件）, what must+主语+动词原形？——问该情境下必须采取的行动。
67.example: If you want to open a bank account, what must you show? — 如果想开银行账户，你必须出示什么？

67.q: Which would you prefer as a snack during a morning break: a bag of crisps or some biscuits?
67.backbone: which疑问句 + 冒号列出选项
67.gloss: 课间点心你更喜欢薯片还是饼干？
chunks: Which would you prefer as a snack during a morning break:
a bag of crisps or some biscuits?
67.rule: Which would you prefer as+类别+during+情境: A or B？——冒号后列出两个具体选项。
67.example: Which would you prefer as a drink during a hot afternoon: a cold juice or some iced tea? — 炎热的下午你更想喝冷果汁还是冰茶？

68.q: Which is the widest street in the place where you live, and which is the narrowest?
68.backbone: which疑问句 + 定语从句 + and并列第二问
68.gloss: 你住的地方哪条街最宽，哪条最窄？
chunks: Which is the widest street in the place where you live,
and which is the narrowest?
68.rule: Which is the 最高级+名词+in+地点(where从句), and which is the 反义最高级？——and并列追问对立极端。
68.example: Which is the tallest building in the city where you work, and which is the oldest? — 你工作的城市里哪栋楼最高，哪栋最古老？

68.q: Would you say that a king’s life was better than that of the average man?
68.backbone: 一般疑问句 + that宾语从句（比较结构）
68.gloss: 你觉得国王的生活比普通人好吗？
chunks: Would you say
that a king’s life was better than that of the average man?
68.rule: Would you say that+主语+过去式+比较级+than that of+名词？——用that of替代重复名词构成比较。
68.example: Would you say that a teacher's salary was lower than that of a doctor? — 你觉得老师的工资比医生低吗？

68.q: If the sky looks dark and cloudy, do you sometimes decide not to go out?
68.backbone: 真实条件句 + 一般疑问句（否定不定式）
68.gloss: 天色阴暗多云时，你有时会决定不出门吗？
chunks: If the sky looks dark and cloudy,
do you sometimes decide not to go out?
68.rule: If+主语+现在时（真实条件描述现象）, do you sometimes decide not to+动词原形？——否定不定式表示决定不做某事。
68.example: If the road looks icy and dangerous, do you sometimes decide not to drive? — 如果路面看起来结冰危险，你有时会决定不开车吗？

69.q: If you drove a car on the left-hand side of the road (in America, France etc.) instead of on the right, what’d happen?
69.backbone: 虚拟条件句（含插入语）+ what疑问句
69.gloss: 如果在美国法国等靠左行驶，会发生什么？
chunks: If you drove a car on the left-hand side of the road
(in America, France etc.)
instead of on the right,
what’d happen?
69.rule: If+主语+过去式（虚拟）, (插入语举例) instead of+介词短语(对比方案), what'd happen？
69.example: If you paid for everything in cash (at restaurants, shops etc.) instead of by card, what'd happen? — 如果所有消费都用现金而不是刷卡，会发生什么？

69.q: If you took something by accident that didn’t belong to you, what’d you do?
69.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + 定语从句修饰宾语 + what疑问句
69.gloss: 不小心拿了不属于你的东西，你会怎么做？
chunks: If you took something by accident
that didn’t belong to you,
what’d you do?
69.rule: If+主语+过去式+宾语+that+定语从句（限定宾语）, what'd you do？——虚拟条件句宾语后加定语从句再问应对。
69.example: If you found some money on the street that nobody claimed, what'd you do? — 如果在街上捡到一笔没人认领的钱，你会怎么做？

69.q: What do we mean when we say that somebody has the manners of a pig?
69.backbone: what疑问句 + when从句嵌套that宾语从句
69.gloss: 说某人有猪一样的举止是什么意思？
chunks: What do we mean
when we say
that somebody has the manners of a pig?
69.rule: What do we mean when we say that+从句（习语/说法）？——嵌套结构用于追问某表达的含义。
69.example: What do we mean when we say that somebody has a heart of gold? — 说某人有一颗金子般的心是什么意思？

70.q: When people lend you money, do you always pay it back when promised?
70.backbone: when时间从句 + 一般疑问句 + when状语
70.gloss: 别人借你钱时，你总能按承诺还钱吗？
chunks: When people lend you money,
do you always pay it back
when promised?
70.rule: When+主语+现在时（从句设定情境）, do you always+动词原形...when+过去分词（省略主语的时间状语）？
70.example: When people give you advice, do you always follow it when necessary? — 别人给你建议时，你总是在必要时听从吗？

70.q: Where’d you have to go if you wanted further information about train times at a station?
70.backbone: where疑问句 + 虚拟条件句
70.gloss: 想了解车站列车时刻信息，该去哪？
chunks: Where’d you have to go
if you wanted further information about train times at a station?
70.rule: Where'd you have to go if+主语+过去式（虚拟条件说明需求）？
70.example: Where'd you have to go if you wanted further information about visa requirements at an embassy? — 如果想在大使馆了解签证要求的更多信息，你得去哪？

70.q: About how long would it take us to reach the station from here if we walked very fast?
70.backbone: how long疑问句 + 虚拟条件句
70.gloss: 走得很快的话，从这到车站大概要多久？
chunks: About how long would it take us to reach the station from here
if we walked very fast?
70.rule: About how long would it take+主语+to+动词原形 if+主语+过去式（虚拟条件设定方式）？
70.example: About how long would it take us to finish the project if we worked all weekend? — 如果整个周末都在干活，大概要多久才能完成这个项目？

71.q: Which would you prefer: a job that gave you the opportunity to visit other countries, or a job that gave you the opportunity to earn a lot?
71.backbone: which疑问句 + 冒号列出两个定语从句并列选项
71.gloss: 你更想要能出国的工作，还是能赚很多钱的工作？
chunks: Which would you prefer:
a job that gave you the opportunity to visit other countries,
or a job that gave you the opportunity to earn a lot?
71.rule: Which would you prefer: 名词+that+定语从句A, or 名词+that+定语从句B？——冒号后并列两个同构定语从句作选项。
71.example: Which would you prefer: a house that gave you a big garden, or a flat that gave you a view of the city? — 你更想要有大花园的房子，还是能看到城市景色的公寓？

71.q: Does the weather have a strong influence over you? Do you, for example, feel happy in good weather and unhappy in bad weather?
71.backbone: 两个疑问句并列，第二句举例说明
71.gloss: 天气对你影响大吗？好天气开心坏天气不开心吗？
chunks: Does the weather have a strong influence over you?
Do you, for example, feel happy in good weather
and unhappy in bad weather?
71.rule: 一般疑问句1（抽象论断）？Do you, for example, +形容词A+in情境A and+形容词B+in情境B？——第二句用插入语举例并and对比正反情境。
71.example: Does your mood depend on the people around you? Do you, for example, feel relaxed with close friends and nervous with strangers? — 你的心情取决于周围的人吗？比如跟熟悉朋友在一起会放松，跟陌生人在一起会紧张吗？

71.q: When you began your lessons at this school, had you already studied some English or were you a complete beginner?
71.backbone: when从句 + 过去完成时or并列过去时选择疑问
71.gloss: 你入学时已学过英语，还是完全零基础？
chunks: When you began your lessons at this school,
had you already studied some English
or were you a complete beginner?
71.rule: When+主语+过去式（时间从句锚定过去某时点）, had+主语+过去分词 or were+主语+表语？——过去完成时vs一般过去时对比先前与当时状态。
71.example: When you started this job, had you already learned some coding or were you a complete novice? — 你开始这份工作时，是已经学过一些编程，还是完全的新手？

72.q: If you forgot to bring a pen with you to school, would you have to borrow one from another student?
72.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + 一般疑问句（是否需要借）
72.gloss: 忘带笔上学的话，你得向同学借吗？
chunks: If you forgot to bring a pen with you to school,
would you have to borrow one from another student?
72.rule: If+主语+过去式（虚拟条件，忘记做某事）, would+主语+have to+动词原形...？——问被迫采取的补救行动。
72.example: If you forgot to bring your ID with you to the airport, would you have to go back home? — 如果去机场忘带身份证，你得回家拿吗？

72.q: Do you think it’s worth learning a foreign language in spite of the fact that it’s quite difficult?
72.backbone: 一般疑问句 + in spite of the fact that让步从句
72.gloss: 尽管外语很难，你觉得值得学吗？
chunks: Do you think it’s worth learning a foreign language
in spite of the fact that it’s quite difficult?
72.rule: Do you think it's worth Ving+宾语 in spite of the fact that+从句？——worth doing接让步从句。
72.example: Do you think it's worth saving money every month in spite of the fact that it's quite hard? — 尽管很难，你觉得每月存钱还是值得的吗？

72.q: In spite of studying a lot of words and grammar, do you still find English a little difficult?
72.backbone: in spite of让步状语前置 + 一般疑问句
72.gloss: 学了很多词汇语法，你还觉得英语有点难吗？
chunks: In spite of studying a lot of words and grammar,
do you still find English a little difficult?
72.rule: In spite of+Ving+宾语（让步状语前置）, do you still+动词原形...？——still强调结果未因让步条件而改变。
72.example: In spite of practicing every day, do you still find the piano a little difficult? — 尽管每天练习，你还是觉得弹钢琴有点难吗？

73.q: Consequently, when we run a hundred yards, do we run further than a hundred metres?
73.backbone: 副词开头 + when从句 + 一般疑问句（比较）
73.gloss: 因此，跑一百码是否比跑一百米更远？
chunks: Consequently, when we run a hundred yards,
do we run further than a hundred metres?
73.rule: 逻辑副词(Consequently)开头, when+主语+现在时从句, do+主语+动词原形+比较级+than+比较对象？——逻辑副词引出推论再用比较疑问句验证。
73.example: Consequently, when we buy a kilogram of apples, do we buy more than a pound of apples? — 因此，买一公斤苹果是否比买一磅苹果买得更多？

73.q: What’d you do if this table slowly began to rise into the air without anybody touching it?
73.backbone: what疑问句 + 虚拟条件句（含伴随状语）
73.gloss: 如果这桌子无人碰触却慢慢升空，你会怎么做？
chunks: What’d you do
if this table slowly began to rise into the air
without anybody touching it?
73.rule: What'd you do if+主语+过去式+began to+动词原形...without anybody+Ving？——without+动名词补充“无人做某事”的伴随情况。
73.example: What'd you do if this door slowly began to open by itself without anybody pushing it? — 如果这扇门无人推却自己慢慢打开，你会怎么做？

73.q: What sometimes happens when we let people borrow things that belong to us?
73.backbone: what疑问句 + when从句 + 定语从句
73.gloss: 让别人借用我们的东西，有时会发生什么？
chunks: What sometimes happens
when we let people borrow things
that belong to us?
73.rule: What sometimes happens when+主语+let+宾语+动词原形...that+定语从句（层层修饰宾语）？
73.example: What sometimes happens when we let children play with toys that are not theirs? — 让孩子玩不属于他们的玩具，有时会发生什么？

74.q: Are you the kind of person who usually has to run hard at the last moment in order to catch a bus or a train?
74.backbone: be疑问句 + 定语从句 + in order to目的状语
74.gloss: 你是那种常常最后一刻狂奔赶车的人吗？
chunks: Are you the kind of person
who usually has to run hard at the last moment
in order to catch a bus or a train?
74.rule: Are you the kind of person who+定语从句（习惯性行为） in order to+动词原形（目的）？
74.example: Are you the kind of person who usually has to stay up late in order to finish work on time? — 你是那种常常得熬夜才能按时完成工作的人吗？

74.q: Do you think it’s OK to let dogs run around loose, or do you think they should be kept on a chain?
74.backbone: 一般疑问句 or 并列另一观点疑问句
74.gloss: 你觉得狗该放养还是该拴链子？
chunks: Do you think it’s OK to let dogs run around loose,
or do you think they should be kept on a chain?
74.rule: Do you think it's OK to+动词原形A, or do you think+主语+should be+过去分词B？——两个宾语从句用or并列呈现对立观点。
74.example: Do you think it's OK to let children eat as much sugar as they want, or do you think their diet should be controlled? — 你觉得该让孩子随便吃糖，还是该控制他们的饮食？

74.q: If you walked in the rain without carrying an umbrella or wearing a raincoat, what might happen?
74.backbone: 虚拟条件句（含伴随状语）+ what疑问句
74.gloss: 不带伞不穿雨衣淋雨走路，可能发生什么？
chunks: If you walked in the rain
without carrying an umbrella or wearing a raincoat,
what might happen?
74.rule: If+主语+过去式（虚拟） without Ving A or Ving B（并列伴随状语）, what might happen？——without并列两个动名词说明缺失的防护措施。
74.example: If you drove at night without turning on your lights or checking your mirrors, what might happen? — 如果夜间开车不开灯也不看后视镜，可能发生什么？

75.q: If you have an important appointment to keep, which member of your family reminds you to keep it?
75.backbone: 真实条件句 + which疑问句
75.gloss: 有重要约会时，家里谁会提醒你？
chunks: If you have an important appointment to keep,
which member of your family reminds you to keep it?
75.rule: If+主语+现在时（真实条件）, which+名词+of+范畴+动词+you to+动词原形？——问范畴内具体是谁做某事。
75.example: If you have a difficult decision to make, which member of your family helps you to make it? — 有难以抉择的决定时，家里谁帮你做决定？

75.q: If you forget the meaning of a word during the lesson, who reminds you of it?
75.backbone: 真实条件句 + who疑问句
75.gloss: 上课忘了词义时，谁会提醒你？
chunks: If you forget the meaning of a word during the lesson,
who reminds you of it?
75.rule: If+主语+现在时（真实条件）, who+动词+you of+宾语？——真实条件句后接who疑问句问施动者。
75.example: If you forget somebody's name at a party, who reminds you of it? — 聚会上忘记某人名字时，谁会提醒你？

75.q: When you were a child, did you sometimes have to go to school even though you didn’t want to?
75.backbone: when时间从句 + 一般疑问句 + even though让步从句
75.gloss: 你小时候有时不情愿也得去上学吗？
chunks: When you were a child,
did you sometimes have to go to school
even though you didn’t want to?
75.rule: When+主语+过去式（时间从句设定阶段）, did+主语+sometimes have to+动词原形...even though+主语+过去式（让步从句）？
75.example: When you were a student, did you sometimes have to do homework even though you didn't feel like it? — 你还是学生时，有时不情愿也得做作业吗？

76.q: If I tell you that I am driving towards Scotland, does that necessarily mean that Scotland is my destination?
76.backbone: 真实条件句（含宾语从句）+ 一般疑问句（含宾语从句）
76.gloss: 说正开车往苏格兰，是否意味着那是目的地？
chunks: If I tell you
that I am driving towards Scotland,
does that necessarily mean
that Scotland is my destination?
76.rule: If+主语+现在时+that宾语从句（给出前提陈述）, does that necessarily mean that+从句（检验推论）？
76.example: If I tell you that I am walking towards the station, does that necessarily mean that the station is my destination? — 如果我说正朝车站走，是否意味着车站就是目的地？

76.q: When a car park is full, where does a driver have to park his car ?
76.gloss: 停车场满了，司机得把车停哪？
chunks: When a car park is full,
where does a driver have to park his car ?
76.rule: When+主语+现在时（从句设定客观情境）, where does+主语+have to+动词原形？——问被迫的应对地点。
76.example: When a restaurant is fully booked, where does a customer have to eat instead? — 餐厅订满时，顾客得改去哪吃饭？

76.q: If you have a problem with your teeth, who should you go to see?
76.backbone: 真实条件句 + who疑问句
chunks: If you have a problem with your teeth,
who should you go to see?
76.rule: If+主语+现在时（真实条件，身体/生活问题）, who should you go to see？——问该求助的专业人士。
76.example: If you have a problem with your eyes, who should you go to see? — 眼睛有问题，该去看谁？

77.q: How do we form the possessive case of plural nouns that do not end in “s“, such as “men”, “women”, “children“ etc.?
77.backbone: how疑问句 + 定语从句 + such as举例
77.gloss: 不以s结尾的复数名词，所有格怎么构成？
chunks: How do we form the possessive case of plural nouns
that do not end in “s“,
such as “men”, “women”, “children“ etc.?
77.rule: How do we form the X of Y that+定语从句（限定范围）, such as+举例 etc.？——语法规则疑问句+定语从句+举例佐证。
77.example: How do we pronounce the past tense of verbs that end in a voiceless consonant, such as “walk”, “watch”, “kiss” etc.? — 以清辅音结尾的动词，过去式怎么读，比如walk、watch、kiss等？

77.q: For what reason? If you were driving a car on a long journey and suddenly felt really tired, what would you do?
77.backbone: 简短追问句 + 虚拟条件句 + what疑问句
77.gloss: 为什么？长途开车突然很累时你会怎么做？
chunks: For what reason?
If you were driving a car on a long journey
and suddenly felt really tired,
what would you do?
77.rule: 简短追问句 + If+主语+过去进行时+and+过去式（虚拟条件内并列两动作）, what would you do？
77.example: For what reason? If you were walking home alone at night and suddenly heard a strange noise, what would you do? — 为什么？深夜独自走路回家突然听到怪声，你会怎么做？

77.q: If you flew round the world in a straight line, would you finish in the same place as you had started?
77.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + 一般疑问句（as比较从句）
77.gloss: 沿直线绕地球飞行，会回到出发地吗？
chunks: If you flew round the world in a straight line,
would you finish in the same place
as you had started?
77.rule: If+主语+过去式（虚拟）, would+主语+动词原形+in the same X as+主语+过去完成时（as比较从句，表更早发生）？
77.example: If you drove around the block twice, would you end up in the same spot as you had begun? — 绕街区开两圈，会回到出发的同一个地方吗？

78.q: When you lend something, like money for example, do you prefer the other person to give it back on a certain date or just as soon as possible?
78.backbone: when从句（含插入语）+ 一般疑问句or并列选项
78.gloss: 借出东西时，你希望对方定期还还是尽快还？
chunks: When you lend something,
like money for example,
do you prefer the other person to give it back on a certain date
or just as soon as possible?
78.rule: When+主语+现在时, like X for example（插入语举例）, do you prefer 宾语 to+动词原形A or+动词短语B？
78.example: When you borrow something, like a book for example, do you prefer the owner to tell you a deadline or just leave it up to you? — 借东西时，比如书，你希望物主定个还期还是随你？

78.q: If you had to choose between having £10,000 now or £40,000 in ten years’ time, which’d you choose?
78.backbone: 虚拟条件句（between…or…比较）+ which疑问句
78.gloss: 现在拿一万镑还是十年后拿四万镑，你选哪个？
chunks: If you had to choose between having £10,000 now
or £40,000 in ten years’ time,
which’d you choose?
78.rule: If+主语+had to choose between A(现在) or B（未来，in+时间段's time）, which'd you choose？——对比现在与未来的量。
78.example: If you had to choose between having a small flat now or a big house in twenty years' time, which'd you choose? — 现在拿小公寓还是二十年后拿大房子，你选哪个？

78.q: If the government of your country decided to build a new national sports stadium, whereabouts do you think it should be?
78.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + whereabouts疑问句（含宾语从句）
78.gloss: 政府要建新体育场，你觉得该建在哪？
chunks: If the government of your country decided to build a new national sports stadium,
whereabouts do you think it should be?
78.rule: If+主语+过去式（虚拟，机构决定做某事）, whereabouts do you think+宾语从句（should be）？——问大致位置而非精确地点。
78.example: If the council of your city decided to build a new public library, whereabouts do you think it should be? — 如果市政府决定建一座新公共图书馆，你觉得大概该建在哪？

79.q: If you had to get to a room that was on the tenth floor of a building, would you take the stairs or the lift?
79.backbone: 虚拟条件句（含定语从句）+ 选择疑问句
79.gloss: 要到十楼房间，你会走楼梯还是坐电梯？
chunks: If you had to get to a room
that was on the tenth floor of a building,
would you take the stairs or the lift?
79.rule: If+主语+had to+动词原形+宾语+that+定语从句（限定宾语）, would you+动词原形A or B（选择）？
79.example: If you had to get to a shop that was at the end of a long street, would you walk or take a bus? — 要到长街尽头的商店，你会走路还是坐公交？

79.q: Which would you rather do this evening: read a book, watch television, or go to the cinema?
79.backbone: which疑问句 + 冒号列举三选项
79.gloss: 今晚你更想读书、看电视还是看电影？
chunks: Which would you rather do this evening:
read a book, watch television,
or go to the cinema?
79.rule: Which would you rather do+时间状语: 动词原形短语A, B, or C？——冒号后列举三个并列动词原形短语。
79.example: Which would you rather do this weekend: visit a museum, go hiking, or stay home and relax? — 这周末你更想去博物馆、去徒步，还是待家里放松？

79.q: Do you think you’d be able to recognize me if we met each other again in thirty years’ time?
79.backbone: 一般疑问句（宾语从句）+ 虚拟条件句
79.gloss: 三十年后再见，你觉得还能认出我吗？
chunks: Do you think you’d be able to recognize me
if we met each other again in thirty years’ time?
79.rule: Do you think+主语+would be able to+动词原形+宾语从句 if+主语+过去式（虚拟条件，含in+时间段's time表示未来某时点）？
79.example: Do you think you'd be able to remember this song if you heard it again in ten years' time? — 十年后再听到这首歌，你觉得还会记得吗？

80.q: The word “fair“ has five different meanings, which are as follows: ___________ (fair hair), ____________ (industrial and agricultural fairs, for example), __________ (just), __________ (moderate), and __________ (fun fair). What are the five meanings of the word “fair“?
80.backbone: 陈述句列举五个填空义项 + what疑问句复述
80.gloss: fair一词有五个含义，列出并复述这五个意思
chunks: The word “fair“ has five different meanings,
which are as follows:
___________ (fair hair), ____________ (industrial and agricultural fairs, for example), __________ (just), __________ (moderate), and __________ (fun fair).
What are the five meanings of the word “fair“?
80.rule: 名词+has+数词+meanings, which are as follows: 冒号列举填空项；What are the+数词+meanings of+名词？——先列举后疑问复述。
80.example: The word “light” has four different meanings, which are as follows: ___ (not heavy), ___ (illumination), ___ (pale in colour), and ___ (to light a fire). What are the four meanings of the word “light”? — light一词有四个含义，列出并复述这四个意思

80.q: What kind? If I asked everyone in this room twenty questions but only asked you two, would that be fair?
80.backbone: 简短追问句 + 真实条件句（but转折）+ 一般疑问句
80.gloss: 哪种？若只问你两个问题却问别人二十个，公平吗？
chunks: What kind?
If I asked everyone in this room twenty questions
but only asked you two,
would that be fair?
80.rule: 简短追问句 + If+主语+过去式+宾语A but+过去式+宾语B（but转折对比不均待遇）, would that be+形容词？
80.example: What kind? If I gave everyone in the class ten minutes but only gave you five, would that be fair? — 哪种？如果给全班十分钟却只给你五分钟，公平吗？

80.q: When do we use the auxiliary verb “do“ in a positive sentence with the present simple tense?
80.backbone: when疑问句（一般现在时肯定句用法）
80.gloss: 一般现在时肯定句何时使用助动词do？
chunks: When do we use the auxiliary verb “do“
in a positive sentence with the present simple tense?
80.rule: When do we use the+语法项 in a+句型 with the+时态？——用介词短语层层限定语法规则的适用场景。
80.example: When do we use the auxiliary verb “did” in a negative sentence with the past simple tense? — 一般过去时否定句中，何时使用助动词did？

81.q: If, on the other hand, I went out of the room and said “I’ll be back within an hour“, at what time would I return?
81.backbone: 虚拟条件句：若过去做某动作，问将来几点
81.gloss: 如果我说一小时内回来，我会几点回来？
chunks: If, on the other hand, I went out of the room
and said “I’ll be back within an hour“,
at what time would I return?
81.rule: If从句用过去式虚拟设想两个连续动作(went…and said…)，主句用“at what time+would+动词原形”倒装问将来的具体时间。
81.example: If, on the other hand, she left the house and said “I’ll call you in ten minutes“, at what time would she phone? — 如果她离开屋子说十分钟后打电话，她会几点打？

81.q: If you bought a business for £1,000,000 and sold it again later for £250,000, would you be making a profit?
81.backbone: 虚拟条件句：若做了买卖，问是否盈利
81.gloss: 如果你这样买卖生意，你会赚钱吗？
chunks: If you bought a business for £1,000,000
and sold it again later for £250,000,
would you be making a profit?
81.rule: If从句用过去式虚拟“买入价+later+卖出价”两个并列动作，主句用“would+主语+be+现在分词”问是否处于某状态。
81.example: If you bought a car for $20,000 and sold it again later for $30,000, would you be making a loss? — 如果你这样买卖车，你会亏钱吗？

81.q: The time now is (6 o’clock). If I went out of the room and said “I’ll be back in an hour“, at what time would I return?
81.backbone: 背景陈述句+虚拟条件句问将来时间
81.gloss: 现在6点，如果我说一小时后回来，几点回来？
chunks: The time now is (6 o’clock).
If I went out of the room
and said “I’ll be back in an hour“,
at what time would I return?
81.rule: 先用现在时给出背景(“The time now is X”)，再接if虚拟条件句(过去式)，主句用“at what time+would+动词原形”问基于背景推算的时间。
81.example: The time now is (3 o’clock). If I left the office and said “I’ll be back in two hours“, at what time would I return? — 现在3点，如果我说两小时后回来，我会几点回来？

82.q: When you make a formal written statement to the police, do you have to put your signature at the end?
82.backbone: when时间状语从句+一般疑问句
82.gloss: 向警方做正式书面陈述时，需要签名吗？
chunks: When you make a formal written statement to the police,
do you have to put your signature at the end?
82.rule: “When+主语+一般现在时动词”表示“每当做某事时”，主句用一般疑问句(do/does+主语+have to+动词原形)问是否必须。
82.example: When you sign a legal contract, do you have to write the date next to your name? — 签法律合同时，需要在名字旁写日期吗？

82.q: If you rode from here to the next town by bicycle, about how long would it take you?
82.backbone: 虚拟条件句：问所需时间
82.gloss: 如果骑车去下一个镇，大概要多久？
chunks: If you rode from here to the next town by bicycle,
about how long would it take you?
82.rule: If从句用过去式虚拟“用某种方式做某事”，主句用“how long+would+it+take+you”询问所需时间。
82.example: If you walked from here to the station, about how long would it take you? — 如果你走路去车站，大概要多久？

82.q: When you finally find something after trying to find it for a long time, what can you say?
82.backbone: when从句(含分词短语)+特殊疑问句
82.gloss: 找了很久终于找到时，你会说什么？
chunks: When you finally find something
after trying to find it for a long time,
what can you say?
82.rule: “When+主语+finally+动词”表结果性时间从句，可插入“after+动名词”补充经过，主句用“what can you say”问反应表达。
82.example: When you finally solve a problem after struggling with it for hours, what can you say? — 苦想几小时终于解出问题时，你会说什么？

83.q: If a kilometre equals about 0.6 (point six) of a mile, how far is it from here to the nearest town in miles?
83.backbone: 条件句给换算比例+问距离
83.gloss: 已知1公里约0.6英里，这里到最近城镇多少英里？
chunks: If a kilometre equals about 0.6 (point six) of a mile,
how far is it from here to the nearest town in miles?
83.rule: If从句陈述一个换算/事实(现在时)，主句用“how far/how much+is it…in+单位”要求用给定比例换算作答。
83.example: If a kilogram equals about 2.2 pounds, how heavy is this bag in pounds? — 已知1公斤约2.2磅，这个包用磅算有多重？

83.q: If I am (5) feet (11) inches tall, about how tall do you think you are in feet and inches?
83.backbone: 条件句给参照身高+问对方身高
83.gloss: 如果我身高5英尺11英寸，你觉得你多高？
chunks: If I am (5) feet (11) inches tall,
about how tall do you think you are in feet and inches?
83.rule: If从句给出说话人自身数据作参照(现在时)，主句用“about how+形容词+do you think you are”让对方以此估算自己的数值。
83.example: If I weigh about 70 kilos, about how much do you think you weigh? — 如果我大约70公斤，你觉得你大概多重？

83.q: If you fell over while you were running along the street, might you hurt yourself?
83.backbone: 虚拟条件句(含while过去进行时)+情态推测
83.gloss: 如果你跑步时摔倒，可能会受伤吗？
chunks: If you fell over
while you were running along the street,
might you hurt yourself?
83.rule: If从句用过去式+while从句(过去进行时)描述“做A时发生B”，主句用“might+主语+动词原形”表推测可能性。
83.example: If you dropped your phone while you were crossing the road, might you lose it? — 如果你过马路时手机掉了，可能会丢吗？

84.q: Right. I will now make some statements and I want you to tell me what I said, using indirect speech. “I swim every day“ – What did I say?
84.backbone: 指令说明+间接引语转换练习+直接引语提问
84.gloss: 我说一句话，你要用间接引语转述我说的话
chunks: Right.
I will now make some statements
and I want you to tell me what I said, using indirect speech.
“I swim every day“ – What did I say?
84.rule: 用“I will+动词 and I want you to+动词”给出练习指令，后接引号内直接引语，再用“What did I say?”要求转述为间接引语。
84.example: Now I will read a sentence and I want you to change it into the passive voice. “They built this house in 1990.“ – What did I say? — 我读一句话，你要改成被动语态，我说了什么？

84.q: Would you think it was a great pity if you went for a picnic in the country and it rained?
84.backbone: 一般疑问句+if虚拟条件从句
84.gloss: 如果你去乡下野餐却下雨了，你会觉得很遗憾吗？
chunks: Would you think it was a great pity
if you went for a picnic in the country and it rained?
84.rule: 主句“Would you think it was+形容词”在前，if虚拟条件从句(过去式，含并列动作)在后，倒装强调情感判断。
84.example: Would you think it was a disaster if you planned a wedding outdoors and it snowed? — 如果你在户外办婚礼却下雪了，你会觉得是场灾难吗？

84.q: Is it generally necessary to use the word “that“ when we use indirect speech?
84.backbone: it形式主语一般疑问句+when状语从句
84.gloss: 用间接引语时，通常有必要用that吗？
chunks: Is it generally necessary to use the word “that“
when we use indirect speech?
84.rule: “Is it+形容词+to+动词”为it形式主语疑问句，接“when+主语+一般现在时”补充适用情境。
84.example: Is it always polite to say “please“ when we make a request? — 提出请求时，说“please”总是礼貌的吗？

85.q: If you could meet whoever you wanted in the world, who would you prefer to meet?
85.backbone: 虚拟条件句(含whoever从句)+特殊疑问句
85.gloss: 如果能见世界上任何人，你想见谁？
chunks: If you could meet whoever you wanted in the world,
who would you prefer to meet?
85.rule: If从句用“could+动词+whoever/whatever+从句”表虚拟的无限制选择，主句用“who+would+you+prefer to+动词”追问具体选择。
85.example: If you could eat whatever you wanted every day, what would you choose to eat? — 如果每天能随便吃任何东西，你会选择吃什么？

85.q: If you could go wherever you liked in the world, where’d you go?
85.backbone: 虚拟条件句(含wherever从句)+特殊疑问句
85.gloss: 如果能去世界上任何地方，你会去哪？
chunks: If you could go wherever you liked in the world,
where’d you go?
85.rule: If从句“could+动词+wherever/whenever+从句”表不受限制的假设，主句用疑问词+’d(would)+动词原形简化追问选择。
85.example: If you could work whenever you liked, when’d you start? — 如果能随时想上班就上班，你会选什么时候开始？

85.q: Do you think that a union of all the countries in Europe (or South America etc.) will ever be possible?
85.backbone: 宾语从句嵌套的一般疑问句
85.gloss: 你觉得欧洲各国联合有可能实现吗？
chunks: Do you think that a union of all the countries in Europe (or South America etc.)
will ever be possible?
85.rule: “Do you think that+从句”引导宾语从句，从句用“will ever be+形容词”询问某事最终是否可能实现。
85.example: Do you think that a cure for all diseases will ever be discovered? — 你觉得治愈所有疾病的方法终将被发现吗？

86.q: Would you be confused if I suddenly walked out of the room for no reason and didn’t come back?
86.backbone: 一般疑问句+if虚拟条件从句
86.gloss: 如果我无缘无故突然离开且不回来，你会困惑吗？
chunks: Would you be confused
if I suddenly walked out of the room for no reason and didn’t come back?
86.rule: 主句“Would you be+形容词”在前，if从句(过去式，含并列否定动作)在后，描述突兀反常行为并问情绪反应。
86.example: Would you be worried if I suddenly stopped answering my phone and didn’t reply for days? — 如果我突然不接电话好几天不回复，你会担心吗？

86.q: If someone tells you that they’re feeling rough, what do they mean?
86.backbone: 真实条件句(含that宾语从句)+特殊疑问句
86.gloss: 如果有人说他们感觉不舒服，是什么意思？
chunks: If someone tells you that they’re feeling rough,
what do they mean?
86.rule: 真实条件句“If someone+一般现在时+that从句”陈述常见说法，主句用“what do they mean”问该说法的含义。
86.example: If someone tells you that they’re feeling blue, what do they mean? — 如果有人说自己“feeling blue”，是什么意思？

86.q: Where? When a table is not level, what must we do?
86.backbone: 追问词+when条件从句+特殊疑问句
86.gloss: 桌子不平时，我们必须怎么做？
chunks: Where?
When a table is not level,
what must we do?
86.rule: 追问词单独成句后，接“When+主语+be动词+not+形容词”条件从句，主句用“what must we do”问应对措施。
86.example: Really? When a door does not close properly, what must we do? — 真的吗？门关不严时，我们必须怎么做？

87.q: If you could play host to three famous guests, which three famous people would you choose?
87.backbone: 虚拟条件句+which引导特殊疑问句
87.gloss: 如果能招待三位名人，你会选哪三位？
chunks: If you could play host to three famous guests,
which three famous people would you choose?
87.rule: If从句“could+动词+数量+名词”虚拟设定名额，主句用“which+名词+would you choose”要求具体点名。
87.example: If you could invite three historical figures to dinner, which three people would you choose? — 如果能请三位历史人物吃饭，你会选哪三位？

87.q: If you had your own company, would you employ someone simply because they were a friend?
87.backbone: 虚拟条件句+because原因状语从句
87.gloss: 如果你有自己的公司，会仅因朋友关系雇人吗？
chunks: If you had your own company,
would you employ someone simply because they were a friend?
87.rule: If从句“had+own+名词”虚拟拥有某物，主句“would you+动词”后接“because+从句”说明可能的理由，问是否会仅凭该理由行动。
87.example: If you had your own restaurant, would you hire someone simply because they were family? — 如果你有自己的餐厅，会仅因是家人就雇人吗？

87.q: If you had to be in charge of a big business, what kind of business would you choose?
87.backbone: 虚拟条件句+特殊疑问句
87.gloss: 如果必须经营一家大公司，你会选哪种行业？
chunks: If you had to be in charge of a big business,
what kind of business would you choose?
87.rule: If从句“had to be in charge of+名词”表被迫承担的虚拟责任，主句用“what kind of+名词+would you choose”问具体选择。
87.example: If you had to be responsible for a school, what kind of school would you choose? — 如果必须负责一所学校，你会选哪种学校？

88.q: If you went to live in another country, do you think you would quickly adopt the way of living in that country?
88.backbone: 虚拟条件句+think宾语从句嵌套问句
88.gloss: 如果移居他国，你觉得会很快适应当地生活方式吗？
chunks: If you went to live in another country,
do you think you would quickly adopt the way of living in that country?
88.rule: If从句(过去式)虚拟迁居设定，主句嵌套“do you think+从句(would+动词)”询问对该假设结果的预测。
88.example: If you moved to a big city, do you think you would quickly get used to the fast pace of life? — 如果搬到大城市，你觉得会很快适应快节奏生活吗？

88.q: If we put a piece of wood or paper into a flame, what happens to it?
88.backbone: 真实条件句(科学事实)+特殊疑问句
88.gloss: 把木头或纸放入火焰，会发生什么？
chunks: If we put a piece of wood or paper into a flame,
what happens to it?
88.rule: 真实条件句“If we+一般现在时+动作”陈述客观科学操作，主句用“what happens to it”问必然结果。
88.example: If we put an ice cube into hot water, what happens to it? — 把冰块放进热水里，会发生什么？

88.q: How long will you have been living in this place for when this year (or season) ends?
88.backbone: 将来完成进行时特殊疑问句+when从句
88.gloss: 到今年/这季结束时，你在这住多久了？
chunks: How long will you have been living in this place for
when this year (or season) ends?
88.rule: 主句用将来完成进行时“will have been+动词ing+for”问持续到未来某点的时长，接“when+从句”限定该未来时间点。
88.example: How long will you have been working at this company for when this project finishes? — 到这个项目结束时，你在这公司工作多久了？

89.q: Right, now I will say something and I want you to repeat it and add a tail question. Remember that, if the main part of the sentence is positive, the tail question is negative, and vice versa. He’s a young man.
89.backbone: 指令说明+反意疑问句规则解释+待转换陈述句
89.gloss: 我说一句话，你要重复并加上反意疑问句
chunks: Right, now I will say something
and I want you to repeat it and add a tail question.
Remember that, if the main part of the sentence is positive, the tail question is negative, and vice versa.
He’s a young man.
89.rule: 用指令句给出练习任务，插入“if…positive…negative…vice versa”说明反意疑问句正反规则，末尾给出待转换的陈述句。
89.example: Right, now I will say something and I want you to change it into a question. Remember that we usually move the auxiliary verb to the front. She has finished her homework. — 我说一句话，你要改成疑问句，记住通常把助动词提前，她做完作业了。

89.q: When there is no auxiliary verb in the main part of the sentence, which verb do we use in the tail question ?
89.backbone: when条件从句+反意疑问句结构提问
89.gloss: 句子主干没有助动词时，反意疑问句用哪个动词？
chunks: When there is no auxiliary verb in the main part of the sentence,
which verb do we use in the tail question ?
89.rule: “When there is/are no+名词+in+范围”陈述某语法条件，主句用“which+名词+do we use”问该条件下的规则解法。
89.example: When there is no subject given in a sentence, which pronoun do we usually add? — 句子没有主语时，我们通常加哪个代词？

89.q: If you had the right by law to do whatever you wished, what’d you do?
89.backbone: 虚拟条件句(含whatever从句)+特殊疑问句
89.gloss: 如果法律允许你做任何想做的事，你会做什么？
chunks: If you had the right by law to do whatever you wished,
what’d you do?
89.rule: If从句“had the right to do+whatever从句”虚拟拥有不受限的权利，主句用疑问词+’d(would)+动词原形问具体行动。
89.example: If you had the freedom to travel wherever you wished, what’d you do first? — 如果你能自由去任何想去的地方，你会先做什么？

90.q: Which would you prefer: an exciting trip to a big city for the weekend or a quiet fortnight on the beach?
90.gloss: 你更喜欢周末去大城市旅行还是海边度假两周？
chunks: Which would you prefer:
an exciting trip to a big city for the weekend
or a quiet fortnight on the beach?
90.rule: “Which would you prefer: A or B?”结构，A、B为两个对比鲜明的名词短语，供二选一作答。
90.example: Which would you prefer: a challenging job with high pay or a relaxed job with more free time? — 你更喜欢高薪有挑战的工作还是轻松多闲暇的工作？

90.q: If you saw someone in difficulty in the sea, how would you try to save their life?
90.backbone: 虚拟条件句+how特殊疑问句
90.gloss: 如果看到有人在海里遇险，你会怎么救他们？
chunks: If you saw someone in difficulty in the sea,
how would you try to save their life?
90.rule: If从句“saw someone in difficulty+地点”虚拟目睹危险场景，主句用“how would you try to+动词”问应对方法。
90.example: If you saw someone trapped in a burning building, how would you try to help them? — 如果看到有人困在着火的楼里，你会怎么帮他们？

90.q: When you close a computer program, does it usually remind you to save your work first?
90.backbone: when时间状语从句+一般疑问句
90.gloss: 关闭电脑程序时，通常会提醒你先保存吗？
chunks: When you close a computer program,
does it usually remind you to save your work first?
90.rule: “When+主语+一般现在时”表习惯性时间条件，主句用“does it usually+动词”问该情境下的通常结果。
90.example: When you turn off your phone, does it usually ask you to confirm first? — 关手机时，通常会先要求你确认吗？

91.q: If you bought a business for £4 million and sold it later for half that amount, would you be gaining by doing so?
91.backbone: 虚拟条件句(并列动作)+一般疑问句
91.gloss: 如果这样买卖生意，你是赚了还是亏了？
chunks: If you bought a business for £4 million
and sold it later for half that amount,
would you be gaining by doing so?
91.rule: If从句用过去式并列“买入价+later+卖出为前者的一半”，主句“would you be+现在分词+by doing so”问该操作是否有利。
91.example: If you bought some shares for $2,000 and sold them later for double that amount, would you be gaining by doing so? — 如果这样买卖股票，卖价是买价两倍，你会赚吗？

91.q: As regards learning a language, would you gain anything by going to the country where it was spoken?
91.backbone: 介词短语状语+一般疑问句(含where定语从句)
91.gloss: 学语言方面，去该语言的国家会有帮助吗？
chunks: As regards learning a language,
would you gain anything by going to the country
where it was spoken?
91.rule: “As regards+名词”点出话题范围，主句“would you gain anything by+动名词”后接where定语从句限定地点，问某做法是否有益。
91.example: As regards improving your cooking, would you learn anything by working in a professional kitchen? — 关于提高厨艺，去专业厨房工作会学到东西吗？

91.q: When you stay at a hotel for one night, does the price you pay usually include breakfast?
91.backbone: when时间状语从句+一般疑问句(含定语从句)
91.gloss: 住酒店一晚时，房价通常含早餐吗？
chunks: When you stay at a hotel for one night,
does the price you pay usually include breakfast?
91.rule: “When+主语+动词+for+时长”表习惯性情境，主句“does+名词(含定语从句the price you pay)+usually+动词”问通常情况。
91.example: When you rent a car for a week, does the price you pay usually include insurance? — 租车一周时，你付的价格通常含保险吗？

92.q: What kind of life do you think is better: a life where you have a set time for doing everything, such as eating, sleeping etc., or a life where you do these things whenever you want?
92.backbone: 选择疑问句(两个where定语从句并列比较)
92.gloss: 你觉得哪种生活更好：定时做事还是随心所欲？
chunks: What kind of life do you think is better:
a life where you have a set time for doing everything, such as eating, sleeping etc.,
or a life where you do these things whenever you want?
92.rule: “What kind of X…better: a X where…or a X where…?”用两个where定语从句对比同一名词，供选择判断。
92.example: What kind of job do you think is better: a job where you follow a fixed schedule, such as office hours, or a job where you work whenever you want? — 你觉得哪种工作更好：固定时间上班还是想工作就工作？

92.q: Now, I will give you a sentence, and you say a sentence with the same meaning, but with a modal: John is able to speak French.
92.backbone: 指令说明+待改写例句(情态动词替换练习)
92.gloss: 我说一句话，你用情态动词改写同义句
chunks: Now, I will give you a sentence,
and you say a sentence with the same meaning, but with a modal:
John is able to speak French.
92.rule: “I will give you a sentence, and you say a sentence…but with X”给出改写指令，末尾附原句。
92.example: Now, I will give you a sentence, and you say a sentence with the same meaning, but in the passive voice: Someone stole my bike. — 我给你一句话，你用被动语态改写同义句：有人偷了我的自行车。

92.q: What did I set down on the table when I came into the room at the beginning of the lesson?
92.backbone: 特殊疑问句+when时间状语从句
92.gloss: 课开始我进屋时，把什么放桌上了？
chunks: What did I set down on the table
when I came into the room at the beginning of the lesson?
92.rule: 特殊疑问句“What did+主语+动词”在前，接“when+从句”限定动作发生的具体时间点。
92.example: What did I pick up from the desk when I left the office yesterday? — 我昨天离开办公室时从桌上拿走了什么？

93.q: If you had just bought a house and then someone told you there was a ghost in it, what would you do, providing, of course, you believed in ghosts?
93.backbone: 虚拟条件句+providing引导的附加条件从句
93.gloss: 如果买了房又被告知有鬼，假设你信鬼，你会怎么做？
chunks: If you had just bought a house
and then someone told you there was a ghost in it,
what would you do,
providing, of course, you believed in ghosts?
93.rule: If从句(过去完成/过去式并列两个动作)虚拟情境，主句“what would you do”后加“providing+从句”补充附加前提条件。
93.example: If you had just adopted a dog and then a neighbour told you it was dangerous, what would you do, providing, of course, you trusted the neighbour? — 如果刚收养了狗却被邻居说它很危险，假设你信邻居，你会怎么做？

93.q: If you came to some crossroads while driving a car and, instead of stopping, you kept straight on, what might happen?
93.backbone: 虚拟条件句(含插入语instead of)+情态推测疑问句
93.gloss: 如果开车到十字路口没停反而直行，会发生什么？
chunks: If you came to some crossroads while driving a car
and, instead of stopping, you kept straight on,
what might happen?
93.rule: If从句(过去式)+while从句描述场景，插入“instead of+动名词”表反常选择，主句用“what might happen”问可能后果。
93.example: If you noticed a fire alarm while sitting in a meeting and, instead of leaving, you stayed seated, what might happen? — 如果开会时听到火警却没走反而坐着，可能会发生什么？

93.q: Is it common in your country for people to rent out rooms in their house – to students, for example?
93.backbone: it形式主语+for people to结构的一般疑问句
93.gloss: 在你们国家，把房间租给学生等常见吗？
chunks: Is it common in your country for people to rent out rooms in their house
– to students, for example?
93.rule: “Is it+形容词+in your country for people to+动词”为it形式主语疑问句，末尾用破折号追加举例说明范围。
93.example: Is it common in your country for people to work from home – freelancers, for example? — 在你们国家，人们在家办公常见吗？比如自由职业者？

94.q: When you are reading a book in your own language and you see a word you don’t know the meaning of, do you take the trouble to look it up in a dictionary or do you just keep on reading?
94.backbone: when时间从句(并列)+选择疑问句
94.gloss: 读母语书遇到生词时，你查词典还是继续读？
chunks: When you are reading a book in your own language
and you see a word you don’t know the meaning of,
do you take the trouble to look it up in a dictionary
or do you just keep on reading?
94.rule: “When+两个并列现在进行时/一般现在时从句”设定情境，主句用“do you…or do you…?”给出两种应对方式供选择。
94.example: When you are watching a film in a foreign language and you hear a phrase you don’t understand, do you pause to look it up or do you just keep on watching? — 看外语电影听到不懂的短语时，你会暂停查还是继续看？

94.q: 59) When there is no auxiliary verb in the main part of the sentence, which verb do we use in the tail question? Give me an example.
94.backbone: 编号习题+when条件从句+疑问句+举例指令
94.gloss: 句子主干没有助动词时反意疑问句用什么动词？举例说明
chunks: 59) When there is no auxiliary verb in the main part of the sentence,
which verb do we use in the tail question?
Give me an example.
94.rule: 编号习题+“When there is/are no+名词”条件从句+疑问句，末尾加“Give me an example.”要求举例佐证答案。
94.example: 12) When a noun ends in a consonant plus “y“, how do we form the plural? Give me an example. — 当名词以辅音加y结尾时，复数怎么构成？举例说明。

94.q: If someone says things about you which are not true, do you think it’s better to defend yourself or just keep quiet?
94.backbone: 虚拟条件句(含which定语从句)+选择疑问句
94.gloss: 如果有人说你的坏话，你觉得该反驳还是沉默？
chunks: If someone says things about you which are not true,
do you think it’s better to defend yourself or just keep quiet?
94.rule: If从句(含which定语从句修饰things)陈述场景，主句用“do you think it’s better to…or…”问两种应对的优劣选择。
94.example: If a colleague takes credit for work which is not theirs, do you think it’s better to speak up or just let it go? — 如果同事把别人的成果说成自己的，你觉得该说出来还是算了？

95.q: If it were night time, and very dark, and we came to an old house standing alone in the country which we thought might be full of ghosts, would you be willing to lead the way into the house?
95.backbone: 虚拟条件句(多重并列+which定语从句)
95.gloss: 如果夜黑到了间可能有鬼的老房子，你愿意带路进去吗？
chunks: If it were night time, and very dark,
and we came to an old house standing alone in the country
which we thought might be full of ghosts,
would you be willing to lead the way into the house?
95.rule: If从句用were虚拟式并列背景状语，接分词短语与which定语从句层层修饰名词，主句问“would you be willing to+动词”意愿。
95.example: If it were midnight, and freezing cold, and we found an old cabin standing alone in the forest which we thought might be abandoned, would you be willing to spend the night there? — 如果半夜严寒中找到一间可能废弃的孤立小屋，你愿意在那过夜吗？

95.q: Do you think that, when a man murders someone, he really realizes what he is doing at the time and realizes the consequences of his actions?
95.backbone: 宾语从句嵌套when状语从句
95.gloss: 你觉得杀人时凶手真的清楚自己在做什么、后果吗？
chunks: Do you think that, when a man murders someone,
he really realizes what he is doing at the time
and realizes the consequences of his actions?
95.rule: “Do you think that+从句”引导宾语从句，从句内嵌“when+插入性时间从句”，并列两个动词(realizes…and realizes…)描述认知程度。
95.example: Do you think that, when a person tells a lie, he really understands why he is doing it and understands the risk of getting caught? — 你觉得一个人撒谎时，真的明白自己为什么这样做、被拆穿的风险吗？

95.q: When the past tense of a regular verb does not end in “ded” or “ted”, how do we pronounce the final sound?
95.backbone: when条件从句+特殊疑问句(语音规则)
95.gloss: 规则动词过去式不以ded/ted结尾时，词尾怎么读？
chunks: When the past tense of a regular verb does not end in “ded” or “ted”,
how do we pronounce the final sound?
95.rule: “When+名词+does not end in A or B”条件从句排除两种特殊情况，主句用“how do we+动词”问一般情况下的规则。
95.example: When the plural of a noun does not end in “s“ or “es“, how do we know it is plural? — 名词复数不以s或es结尾时，我们怎么知道它是复数？

96.q: In this town, are there few good restaurants, a few good restaurants, or many good restaurants?
96.backbone: 地点状语+三选一疑问句(few/a few/many辨析)
96.gloss: 这个镇上好餐馆是很少、有些还是很多？
chunks: In this town,
are there few good restaurants, a few good restaurants,
or many good restaurants?
96.rule: 地点状语开头，主句用“are there+量词A, 量词B, or 量词C+名词?”三选一辨析近义量词(few/a few/many)的用法差异。
96.example: In this city, are there little public transport, a little public transport, or a lot of public transport? — 这座城市的公共交通是很少、有一点还是很多？

96.q: If a couple go to a restaurant together, do you think they should each pay half the bill?
96.backbone: 真实条件句+think引导的宾语从句问句
96.gloss: 情侣一起下馆子，你觉得该各付一半账单吗？
chunks: If a couple go to a restaurant together,
do you think they should each pay half the bill?
96.rule: 真实条件句“If+主语+一般现在时”陈述常见情境，主句“do you think they should+动词”问对该情境下应然做法的看法。
96.example: If friends go on a trip together, do you think they should each pay their own expenses? — 如果朋友一起旅行，你觉得该各自付各自的花费吗？

96.q: Do you think you have little free time, a little free time, or a lot of free time?
96.backbone: 三选一疑问句(little/a little/a lot辨析)
96.gloss: 你觉得自己空闲时间很少、有一点还是很多？
chunks: Do you think you have little free time, a little free time,
or a lot of free time?
96.rule: “Do you think you have+量词A, 量词B, or 量词C+名词?”三选一辨析little/a little/a lot of的用法差异，让学习者自我评估。
96.example: Do you think you have little patience, a little patience, or a lot of patience? — 你觉得自己耐心很少、有一点还是很多？

97.q: Would you say that, on the whole, life was better today than it was in the past?
97.backbone: 倒装插入语+比较句：整体上今昔对比
97.gloss: 总体而言，你觉得如今生活比过去好吗？
chunks: Would you say that,
on the whole,
life was better today
than it was in the past?
97.rule: 「Would you say that + 从句」是委婉征求看法的问句框架，从句中插入语(on the whole)加「比较级+than」对比两个时期。
97.example: Would you say that, in general, cities are safer today than they were fifty years ago? — 总体而言，你觉得现今城市比五十年前更安全吗？

97.q: If you go to stay at a friend's for one night, do you take a lot of luggage with you?
97.backbone: 条件句(if+一般现在)+一般疑问句
97.gloss: 如果去朋友家住一晚，你会带很多行李吗？
chunks: If you go to stay at a friend's for one night,
do you take a lot of luggage with you?
97.rule: 「If+一般现在时」描述假设情境，接一般疑问句(do/does+主语+动词)询问对应的日常行为习惯。
97.example: If you go to work by bike every day, do you wear a helmet for safety? — 如果你每天骑车上班，你会戴头盔保证安全吗？

97.q: If a man has rough skin on his hands, what is that probably a sign of?
97.backbone: 条件句+介词后置的特殊疑问句
97.gloss: 如果一个人手上皮肤粗糙，那可能说明什么？
chunks: If a man has rough skin on his hands,
what is that probably a sign of?
97.rule: 「If+一般现在时」描述现象，接「what is that probably a sign of?」，介词of的宾语被疑问词提到句首。
97.example: If a woman has dark circles under her eyes, what is that probably a sign of? — 如果一个女人眼下有黑眼圈，那可能是什么的迹象？

98.q: Why? If you were walking along the street and a stranger tried to give you money for no reason, would you reject the offer?
98.backbone: 虚拟条件句+and并列从句+would疑问
98.gloss: 如果陌生人无缘无故想给你钱，你会拒绝吗？
chunks: Why?
If you were walking along the street
and a stranger tried to give you money for no reason,
would you reject the offer?
98.rule: 「If+过去式/过去进行时」构成虚拟条件，and并列一个新主语的过去式分句，主句用would+原形提出假设性询问。
98.example: Why? If you were sitting in a park and a stranger asked to take your photo, would you agree to it? — 如果你在公园坐着，陌生人想给你拍照，你会同意吗？

98.q: If you borrowed a friend's bicycle and damaged it in an accident, would you pay to have it fixed?
98.backbone: 虚拟条件句+and并列谓语+would疑问
98.gloss: 如果借朋友自行车出事故弄坏了，你会花钱修吗？
chunks: If you borrowed a friend's bicycle
and damaged it in an accident,
would you pay to have it fixed?
98.rule: 「If+过去式」表虚拟条件，and并列同主语的第二个过去式动作，主句would+原形，可接have it done使役结构。
98.example: If you borrowed a neighbour's ladder and broke a rung while using it, would you offer to buy a new one? — 如果借邻居的梯子用坏了一根横档，你会主动买新的赔偿吗？

98.q: Now, I will say a statement and I want you to change it into a question: Michael can play the guitar.
98.backbone: 指令句(陈述句改疑问句练习)+待转换例句
98.gloss: 我说一句话，请你把它改成疑问句：迈克尔会弹吉他。
chunks: Now, I will say a statement
and I want you to change it into a question:
Michael can play the guitar.
98.rule: 「Now, I will+动词1 and I want you to+动词2」给出练习指令，冒号后附待操作的示例句，套用不同动词可换练习类型。
98.example: Now, I will read a sentence and I want you to make it negative: She has finished her homework. — 我读一句话，请你改成否定句：她已经做完作业了。

99.q: If a relation of yours died and left you some land, or other property, where'd you have to go in order to claim it legally?
99.backbone: 虚拟条件句+并列谓语+特殊疑问句+目的状语
99.gloss: 如果亲属去世留给你土地或财产，你得去哪里合法继承？
chunks: If a relation of yours died
and left you some land, or other property,
where'd you have to go
in order to claim it legally?
99.rule: 「If+过去式」and并列第二个过去式谓语，主句特殊疑问句(where'd=where would)后加「in order to+动词原形」表目的。
99.example: If a company closed down and owed you unpaid wages, where'd you have to go in order to claim the money legally? — 如果公司倒闭还欠你工资，你该去哪里合法追讨？

99.q: Which is the main clause in this sentence? “If I don't sleep enough, I feel tired.”
99.backbone: 语法提问句+引用例句(条件句)
99.gloss: 这句话的主句是哪个？如果睡不够我会累。
chunks: Which is the main clause in this sentence?
“If I don't sleep enough, I feel tired.”
99.rule: 「Which is the+语法术语+in this sentence?」提出语法辨析问题，随后引号内给出待分析的完整例句。
99.example: Which is the subordinate clause in this sentence? “Because it was raining, we stayed indoors.” — 这句话里哪个是从句？因为下雨，我们待在了室内。

99.q: If someone hit your car and it was definitely their fault, could you claim damages against them?
99.backbone: 虚拟条件句+并列分句+could疑问
99.gloss: 如果有人撞了你的车且确实是他们的错，你能索赔吗？
chunks: If someone hit your car
and it was definitely their fault,
could you claim damages against them?
99.rule: 「If+过去式」and并列一个新主语的过去式分句(补充说明责任)，主句用could+原形询问权限/可能性。
99.example: If a shop sold you a broken item and it was clearly their mistake, could you demand a full refund? — 如果商店卖给你的东西是坏的，且明显是他们的错，你能要求全额退款吗？

100.q: If you had had the choice of being born in any period throughout history, which period would you have chosen?
100.backbone: 过去完成虚拟条件句(与过去事实相反)+特殊疑问句
100.gloss: 如果能选择出生在历史上任一时期，你会选哪个？
chunks: If you had had the choice of being born in any period throughout history,
which period would you have chosen?
100.rule: 「If+主语+had had/had+过去分词」表与过去事实相反的虚拟条件，主句「which+名词+would you have+过去分词」呼应。
100.example: If you had had the chance of living in any country throughout history, which country would you have picked? — 如果能选择在历史上任一国家生活，你会选哪个国家？

100.q: Do you believe that people are all more or less the same throughout the world, or do you believe there are real basic differences?
100.backbone: or并列的两个宾语从句疑问句
100.gloss: 你认为世界各地的人大体相同，还是认为存在根本差异？
chunks: Do you believe that people are all more or less the same throughout the world,
or do you believe there are real basic differences?
100.rule: 「Do you believe that+从句A, or do you believe+从句B?」用or重复主句框架，并列两个对立的宾语从句供选择。
100.example: Do you believe that most people are basically honest, or do you believe most people will lie when it suits them? — 你认为大多数人本质诚实，还是认为人在方便时都会撒谎？

100.q: Why is it that children so often don't know how to behave themselves when there are no adults to watch over them?
100.backbone: 强调句型(Why is it that...)+when状语从句
100.gloss: 为什么没有大人看管时孩子常常不懂规矩？
chunks: Why is it that children so often don't know how to behave themselves
when there are no adults to watch over them?
100.rule: 「Why is it that+从句」强调句式突出对某现象的疑问，句末加「when+状语从句」补充该现象发生的条件。
100.example: Why is it that people so often forget their manners when they're stuck in traffic? — 为什么人们堵车时常常忘了礼貌？

101.q: Now, I will say two sentences and I want you to join them together using a relative clause. Yesterday, I saw a film. The film lasted for three hours.
101.backbone: 指令句(定语从句合并练习)+两个待合并简单句
101.gloss: 我说两句话，请你用定语从句合并：昨天看的电影长达三小时。
chunks: Now, I will say two sentences
and I want you to join them together using a relative clause.
Yesterday, I saw a film.
The film lasted for three hours.
101.rule: 「Now, I will+动词1 and I want you to+动词2 using a relative clause.」后接两个待合并的简单句，靠共同名词连接。
101.example: Now, I will say two sentences and I want you to join them together using a relative clause. Last week, I met a woman. The woman used to be a pilot. — 我说两句话，请你用定语从句合并：上周遇到的女人曾是飞行员。

101.q: When you're in a restaurant, do you get irritated if people at another table are talking very loudly?
101.backbone: 时间状语从句+主句+if条件从句
101.gloss: 在餐厅时，如果别桌的人大声说话你会烦吗？
chunks: When you're in a restaurant,
do you get irritated
if people at another table are talking very loudly?
101.rule: 「When+时间状语从句, +一般疑问句主句 + if+条件从句」层层缩小场景：先给大背景，再加具体触发条件。
101.example: When you're on a train, do you feel annoyed if someone next to you is playing loud music? — 在火车上，如果邻座大声放音乐你会觉得烦吗？

101.q: As a rule, do people in your town go to the cinema more on Saturday evenings than on Sunday evenings or vice versa?
101.gloss: 通常你镇上的人周六还是周日晚上更常去看电影？
chunks: As a rule,
do people in your town go to the cinema more on Saturday evenings
than on Sunday evenings or vice versa?
101.rule: 「As a rule,」引出一般疑问句，内嵌「more...than」比较两个选项，句末加「or vice versa」涵盖相反情况。
101.example: As a rule, do people in your office work harder in the morning than in the afternoon or vice versa? — 通常你办公室的人是上午还是下午更努力工作？

102.q: If you were an employer and one of your employees phoned you to say that they were feeling a bit ill, would you think that was a good enough reason for them not to come to work?
102.backbone: 虚拟条件句+嵌套宾语从句+would疑问(理由是否充分)
102.gloss: 如果你是雇主，员工称不适请假，你觉得理由充分吗？
chunks: If you were an employer
and one of your employees phoned you to say that they were feeling a bit ill,
would you think that was a good enough reason for them not to come to work?
102.rule: 「If+虚拟条件」and并列一个内含「say that+宾语从句」的分句，主句「would you think that+从句」评价理由是否充分。
102.example: If you were a teacher and one of your students emailed you to say that they had lost their homework, would you think that was a good enough excuse for a late submission? — 如果你是老师，学生说作业丢了，你觉得理由够充分迟交吗？

102.q: If someone tells you that they would like some coffee, and you would also like some coffee, what can you reply?
102.backbone: 条件句+并列分句+特殊疑问句(应答方式)
102.gloss: 如果对方说想喝咖啡而你也想喝，可以怎么回答？
chunks: If someone tells you that they would like some coffee,
and you would also like some coffee,
what can you reply?
102.rule: 「If someone tells you that+从句」and并列「you+also+同样情况」，主句「what can you reply?」询问附和别人的固定应答方式。
102.example: If someone tells you that they hate the cold, and you hate the cold too, what can you say? — 如果对方说讨厌寒冷，你也讨厌，你可以怎么说？

102.q: If someone tells you that they couldn't sleep last night, and you couldn't sleep either, what can you reply?
102.backbone: 条件句+否定并列分句+特殊疑问句(附和用法)
102.gloss: 如果对方说昨晚没睡好，你也没睡好，可以怎么回答？
chunks: If someone tells you that they couldn't sleep last night,
and you couldn't sleep either,
what can you reply?
102.rule: 「If someone tells you that+否定从句」and并列「you+否定+either」表同样的否定情况，主句问该如何附和的应答语。
102.example: If someone tells you that they didn't enjoy the film, and you didn't enjoy it either, what can you reply? — 如果对方说不喜欢这部电影，你也不喜欢，你可以怎么回答？

103.q: Why not? Or, what have you determined to do? When you start to do something like learning a language, are you usually determined to continue to the end even though what you have started is extremely difficult?
103.backbone: 追问句+when状语从句+even though让步从句
103.gloss: 开始学语言等事时，即使很难你是否会坚持到底？
chunks: Why not?
Or, what have you determined to do?
When you start to do something like learning a language,
are you usually determined to continue to the end
even though what you have started is extremely difficult?
103.rule: 两个追问句起头，接「When+状语从句(like+举例)」+一般疑问句，句末「even though what从句作主语」表让步。
103.example: Why not? Or, what have you decided instead? When you begin something like training for a marathon, are you usually willing to keep going even though what you have started is exhausting? — 开始训练马拉松这类事时，即使很累你通常会坚持下去吗？

103.q: For success in life generally, which do you think is more important than anything else: the determination to succeed, luck, hard work, or intelligence?
103.backbone: 插入语疑问句(do you think)+并列选项列举
103.gloss: 对人生成功来说，决心、运气、努力、智力哪个最重要？
chunks: For success in life generally,
which do you think is more important than anything else:
the determination to succeed, luck, hard work, or intelligence?
103.rule: 「For+目的状语,」引出「which do you think is more important than anything else:」，冒号后并列名词短语列出可选项。
103.example: For happiness in life generally, which do you think is more important than anything else: good health, money, friendship, or freedom? — 对人生幸福来说，健康、金钱、友谊、自由哪个最重要？

103.q: If someone steals your umbrella, does that mean you have the right to steal someone else's?
103.backbone: 条件句+mean引导的宾语从句疑问句
103.gloss: 如果有人偷你的伞，就意味着你有权偷别人的吗？
chunks: If someone steals your umbrella,
does that mean you have the right to steal someone else's?
103.rule: 「If+一般现在时假设」，接「does that mean+宾语从句(you have the right to+动词原形)?」构成以偏概全的反问推理。
103.example: If someone lies to you, does that mean you have the right to lie to them too? — 如果有人对你撒谎，是不是意味着你也有权对他撒谎？

104.q: Do you think that the personal freedom of the individual is important, or do you think that the individual ought to be made to do the same things and live in the same way as other people?
104.backbone: or并列两个宾语从句疑问句+被动使役结构
104.gloss: 你认为个人自由重要，还是该被迫与他人一致？
chunks: Do you think that the personal freedom of the individual is important,
or do you think that the individual ought to be made to do the same things
and live in the same way as other people?
104.rule: 「Do you think that+从句A, or do you think that+从句B?」并列两观点，从句B用「be made to do」被动使役表示被迫。
104.example: Do you think that a child's own opinion should be respected, or do you think that children ought to be made to obey their parents in everything? — 你认为该尊重孩子意见，还是孩子该被迫事事听从父母？

104.q: If you buy clothes and find out later that they don't fit you properly, what do you do?
104.backbone: 条件句+并列谓语+特殊疑问句
104.gloss: 如果买的衣服后来发现不合身，你会怎么做？
chunks: If you buy clothes
and find out later that they don't fit you properly,
what do you do?
104.rule: 「If+一般现在时」and并列第二个谓语「find out later that+从句」，主句「what do you do?」询问应对方式。
104.example: If you order food online and find out later that they sent you the wrong dish, what do you do? — 如果网上点餐后发现送错了菜，你会怎么做？

104.q: Why do we use the words “so” and “not” when replying to something that someone has just said?
104.backbone: 特殊疑问句+when状语从句+定语从句
104.gloss: 回应别人刚说的话时，为什么用so和not这两个词？
chunks: Why do we use the words “so” and “not”
when replying to something
that someone has just said?
104.rule: 「Why do we use the words “X” and “Y”」接「when+状语从句」，从句内再嵌「that从句」定语，追问某类词的使用场合。
104.example: Why do we use the words “too” and “either” when agreeing with something that someone has just said? — 附和别人刚说的话时，为什么用too和either这两个词？

105.q: If you could be in the audience at any concert, who would you like to see?
105.backbone: 虚拟条件句+特殊疑问句
105.gloss: 如果能去任何一场音乐会当观众，你想看谁？
chunks: If you could be in the audience at any concert,
who would you like to see?
105.rule: 「If you could+动词原形+at any+名词」表虚拟能力，主句「who/what would you like to+动词原形?」询问理想选择。
105.example: If you could be a guest at any wedding, whose wedding would you like to attend? — 如果能去参加任何一场婚礼，你想去谁的婚礼？

105.q: What do you do in the evening when it’s so cold that it’d be unpleasant to go out?
105.backbone: 特殊疑问句+when从句+so...that结果状语从句
105.gloss: 天冷得出门难受时，你晚上会做什么？
chunks: What do you do in the evening
when it’s so cold
that it’d be unpleasant to go out?
105.rule: 「What do you do+时间状语」接「when+从句」，从句内用「so+形容词+that+结果状语从句」描述极端条件。
105.example: What do you do at the weekend when it’s so hot that it’d be unbearable to stay indoors? — 天热得待在室内难受时，你周末会做什么？

105.q: Which of these two sentences is correct: “John got up quite late today” or “John has got up quite late today”?
105.backbone: 语法辨析疑问句+引用对比例句
105.gloss: 这两句哪个对：一般过去式还是现在完成时？
chunks: Which of these two sentences is correct:
“John got up quite late today”
or “John has got up quite late today”?
105.rule: 「Which of these two sentences is correct: “A” or “B”?」冒号后给出仅时态/结构不同的一对例句供辨析选择。
105.example: Which of these two sentences is correct: “She has lived here for ten years” or “She lives here for ten years”? — 这两句哪个对：现在完成时还是一般现在时表持续？

106.q: When you lack sufficient money to buy something, do you wait and save the money or do you buy it on credit?
106.backbone: 时间状语从句+or并列选择疑问句
106.gloss: 钱不够买东西时，你是攒钱还是赊账购买？
chunks: When you lack sufficient money to buy something,
do you wait and save the money
or do you buy it on credit?
106.rule: 「When+状语从句」交代场景，主句用「do you+动词A or do you+动词B?」重复疑问框架给出两种对立做法。
106.example: When you don't have enough time to cook dinner, do you order takeaway or do you skip the meal? — 没时间做饭时，你是点外卖还是干脆不吃？

106.q: If someone rang you while you were busy talking to another person, would you answer the call?
106.backbone: 虚拟条件句+while时间状语从句+would疑问
106.gloss: 如果你正忙着和别人说话时有人打电话，你会接吗？
chunks: If someone rang you
while you were busy talking to another person,
would you answer the call?
106.rule: 「If+过去式虚拟条件」接「while+过去进行时状语从句」表同时发生的动作，主句would+原形询问应对。
106.example: If someone knocked on your door while you were busy cooking dinner, would you answer it? — 如果你正忙着做饭时有人敲门，你会去开门吗？

106.q: When people are married, which hand and finger do they wear their wedding rings on?
106.backbone: 时间状语从句+介词后置的特殊疑问句
106.gloss: 结婚后人们把婚戒戴在哪只手的哪根手指上？
chunks: When people are married,
which hand and finger do they wear their wedding rings on?
106.rule: 「When+状语从句」交代前提，主句「which+名词1+and+名词2+do+主语+动词...on?」介词后置询问具体位置。
106.example: When people go swimming, which arm and leg do they move first in this stroke? — 游泳时，这个泳姿里人们先动哪条胳膊和哪条腿？

107.q: Now, I will make some requests and I want you to tell me what I said. Could you lend me your book, please?
107.backbone: 指令句(转述请求练习)+待转述的礼貌请求句
107.gloss: 我提一些请求，请你转述我说的话：能借我你的书吗？
chunks: Now, I will make some requests
and I want you to tell me what I said.
Could you lend me your book, please?
107.rule: 「Now, I will+动词1 and I want you to tell me what I said.」是转述练习通用指令，后接一句待转述的礼貌请求。
107.example: Now, I will make some suggestions and I want you to tell me what I said. Why don't we go for a walk? — 我提一些建议，请你转述我说的话：我们何不去散步？

107.q: Now, I will ask you some questions and I want you to tell me what I said. How old are you?
107.backbone: 指令句(转述问句练习)+待转述的特殊疑问句
107.gloss: 我问一些问题，请你转述我说的话：你多大了？
chunks: Now, I will ask you some questions
and I want you to tell me what I said.
How old are you?
107.rule: 同一指令模板套用不同动词(ask)，后接待转述的特殊疑问句，练习直接引语转间接引语。
107.example: Now, I will ask you some questions and I want you to tell me what I said. Where do you live? — 我问一些问题，请你转述我说的话：你住哪里？

107.q: Now, I will give you some orders and I want you to tell me what I said. “Stand up!”
107.backbone: 指令句(转述命令练习)+待转述的祈使句
107.gloss: 我下一些命令，请你转述我说的话：站起来！
chunks: Now, I will give you some orders
and I want you to tell me what I said.
“Stand up!”
107.rule: 同一指令模板套用动词(give orders)，后接待转述的祈使句(引号标出直接引语)，转述为间接命令。
107.example: Now, I will give you some orders and I want you to tell me what I said. “Sit down!” — 我下一些命令，请你转述我说的话：坐下！

108.q: If you had a car accident but your car was hardly damaged, would you get it repaired or would you just leave it?
108.backbone: 虚拟条件句+but转折+or并列选择疑问句
108.gloss: 如果出车祸但车几乎没损坏，你会去修还是不管？
chunks: If you had a car accident
but your car was hardly damaged,
would you get it repaired
or would you just leave it?
108.rule: 「If+过去式」but转折补充意外的结果，主句「would you+动词A or would you+动词B?」并列两种应对选择。
108.example: If you found a wallet on the street but it had hardly any money in it, would you hand it in or would you just leave it there? — 如果在街上捡到钱包但里面几乎没钱，你会上交还是不管？

108.q: Do you agree it's dangerous for a young child to cross the road unless they have an adult with them?
108.backbone: 宾语从句疑问句+unless条件从句
108.gloss: 你同意没有大人陪同小孩过马路很危险吗？
chunks: Do you agree it's dangerous for a young child to cross the road
unless they have an adult with them?
108.rule: 「Do you agree+宾语从句(it's+形容词+for sb to do)」句末加「unless+条件从句」表示「除非...否则」的限定情况。
108.example: Do you agree it's risky for a beginner to go diving unless they have an instructor with them? — 你同意没有教练陪同，初学者潜水很冒险吗？

108.q: Would you say it were hardly possible for a man to live all his life without ever being ill once?
108.backbone: 虚拟语气疑问句(it were)+不定式主语+without短语
108.gloss: 你觉得一个人一生从未生过病几乎不可能吗？
chunks: Would you say it were hardly possible
for a man to live all his life
without ever being ill once?
108.rule: 「Would you say it were hardly possible」虚拟宾语从句接「for sb to do」，句末「without ever+动名词」强调极端否定。
108.example: Would you say it were hardly possible for a person to travel the whole world without ever feeling homesick once? — 你觉得一个人环游世界却从未想家几乎不可能吗？

109.q: If you were walking across a park and a ball rolled your way, would you kick it back to its owner or would you pick it up and throw it back?
109.backbone: 虚拟条件句+并列+or并列选择疑问句
109.gloss: 如果球滚到你面前，你会踢回去还是捡起来扔回去？
chunks: If you were walking across a park
and a ball rolled your way,
would you kick it back to its owner
or would you pick it up and throw it back?
109.rule: 「If+过去进行时」and并列新主语的过去式分句，主句「would you+动词A or would you+动词B(可再and并列)?」给出两种应对方式。
109.example: If you were sitting on a bus and a child dropped their toy near you, would you hand it back to them or would you just ignore it? — 如果你坐公交时小孩的玩具掉在你旁边，你会捡还给他还是不管？

109.q: What words can we use when we want to emphasize the person who does the action in a particular sentence?
109.backbone: 特殊疑问句+when从句+定语从句嵌套
109.gloss: 想强调句子中动作发出者时，可以用什么词？
chunks: What words can we use
when we want to emphasize the person
who does the action in a particular sentence?
109.rule: 「What+名词+can we use」接「when+状语从句」，从句内再嵌「定语从句(who...)」修饰宾语，询问某功能对应的词汇。
109.example: What tenses can we use when we want to describe an action that is still happening now? — 想描述现在仍在进行的动作时，可以用什么时态？

109.q: Have you ever been anywhere in the world that was so hot that you couldn’t stand the heat?
109.backbone: 现在完成时疑问句+定语从句+so...that结果状语
109.gloss: 你去过热到让人受不了的地方吗？
chunks: Have you ever been anywhere in the world
that was so hot
that you couldn’t stand the heat?
109.rule: 「Have you ever been/done+anywhere/anything」现在完成时经历句，接「that was so+形容词」再嵌「that+结果从句」。
109.example: Have you ever eaten anything so spicy that you couldn’t finish the meal? — 你吃过辣到让你吃不完的东西吗？

110.q: If someone said that they were planning to go on holiday but that nothing had been settled yet, what would they mean?
110.backbone: 虚拟条件句+并列宾语从句+特殊疑问句
110.gloss: 如果有人说打算度假但还没定下来，那是什么意思？
chunks: If someone said that they were planning to go on holiday
but that nothing had been settled yet,
what would they mean?
110.rule: 「If someone said that+从句A」but重复that引出对立的从句B(被动完成时)，主句「what would they mean?」询问隐含意义。
110.example: If someone said that they wanted to change jobs but that nothing had been decided yet, what would they mean? — 如果有人说想换工作但还没定下来，那是什么意思？

110.q: Why or why not? If you couldn’t settle your bill in a restaurant because you didn’t have enough money with you, what would you do?
110.backbone: 追问句+虚拟条件句+because原因从句+特殊疑问句
110.gloss: 如果因为钱不够没法在餐厅结账，你会怎么办？
chunks: Why or why not?
If you couldn’t settle your bill in a restaurant
because you didn’t have enough money with you,
what would you do?
110.rule: 追问句起头，接「If+过去式虚拟条件」+「because+原因从句」补充理由，主句「what would you do?」询问应对办法。
110.example: Why or why not? If you couldn’t pay for your shopping because your card was declined, what would you do? — 如果因为卡被拒付没法结账，你会怎么办？

110.q: Correct the mistake in this sentence, please: London, that is the capital of England, is a big city.
110.backbone: 指令句(改错练习)+含定语从句误用的例句
110.gloss: 请改正这句话的错误：伦敦是英格兰首都，是座大城市。
chunks: Correct the mistake in this sentence, please:
London, that is the capital of England, is a big city.
110.rule: 「Correct the mistake in this sentence, please:」冒号后给出含语法错误(此处that误用作非限制性定语从句)的例句供改正。
110.example: Correct the mistake in this sentence, please: My brother, who name is Tom, works abroad. — 请改正这句话的错误：我哥哥，名字叫汤姆，在国外工作。

111.q: When you post a letter, do you take it to a post office or do you just put it in the nearest postbox?
111.backbone: 时间状语从句+or并列选择疑问句
111.gloss: 寄信时，你是送去邮局还是投最近的邮筒？
chunks: When you post a letter,
do you take it to a post office
or do you just put it in the nearest postbox?
111.rule: 「When+状语从句」交代场景，主句「do you+动词A or do you+动词B?」重复框架并列两种具体做法。
111.example: When you need cash urgently, do you go to a bank or do you just use the nearest ATM? — 急需现金时，你是去银行还是用最近的取款机？

111.q: If someone said they wanted a quiet holiday, which part of this country would you recommend to them?
111.backbone: 虚拟条件句+特殊疑问句
111.gloss: 如果有人想要安静的假期，你会推荐国内哪个地方？
chunks: If someone said they wanted a quiet holiday,
which part of this country would you recommend to them?
111.rule: 「If someone said+宾语从句」表虚拟条件，主句「which+名词+would you recommend to them?」询问针对该需求的建议。
111.example: If someone said they wanted to try authentic local food, which restaurant would you recommend to them? — 如果有人说想尝地道本地菜，你会推荐他们哪家餐厅？

111.q: If we know the name of the person we are writing to, how do we begin a formal letter or email?
111.backbone: 条件句(含定语从句)+特殊疑问句
111.gloss: 如果知道收信人姓名，正式信件邮件该怎么开头？
chunks: If we know the name of the person
we are writing to,
how do we begin a formal letter or email?
111.rule: 「If+条件从句」内嵌省略that/who的定语从句修饰宾语，主句「how do we+动词原形?」询问在该条件下的规范做法。
111.example: If we don't know the gender of the person we are emailing, how do we address them politely? — 如果不知道收件人性别，我们该怎样礼貌称呼？

112.q: Why? Supposing there was a place, shall we say, somewhere in the middle of a jungle in South America, where you knew for sure that there was about fifty million pounds’ worth of gold, but the chances of returning alive were only fifty-fifty, would you go and take a chance and try your luck, or would you just stay at home and dream about it?
112.backbone: 虚拟条件句(Supposing)+定语从句+but转折+or并列疑问句
112.gloss: 假如丛林深处有五千万镑黄金但生还几率对半，你会冒险还是留家？
chunks: Why?
Supposing there was a place, shall we say,
somewhere in the middle of a jungle in South America,
where you knew for sure that there was about fifty million pounds’ worth of gold,
but the chances of returning alive were only fifty-fifty,
would you go and take a chance and try your luck, or would you just stay at home and dream about it?
112.rule: 「Supposing there was+地点」引出虚拟假设，接定语从句(where...)细化情境，but转折补代价，主句or并列两种反应。
112.example: Supposing there was an island, shall we say, somewhere far out in the ocean, where you knew for sure that there was buried treasure worth a fortune, but the chances of finding it were only slim, would you set sail and try your luck, or would you just stay home and forget about it? — 假如海上有座藏着巨额宝藏的岛屿但找到几率很小，你会出海冒险还是留在家？

112.q: When a person is rich, do you think it’s due to the fact that they’re more intelligent than most other people, or do you think it’s mainly due to luck?
112.backbone: 时间状语从句+or并列宾语从句疑问句
112.gloss: 人富有是因为更聪明，还是主要靠运气？
chunks: When a person is rich,
do you think it’s due to the fact that they’re more intelligent than most other people,
or do you think it’s mainly due to luck?
112.rule: 「When+状语从句」交代现象，主句「do you think it's due to+从句A, or do you think it's due to+名词B?」并列两种归因。
112.example: When a person is successful, do you think it's due to the fact that they work harder than most other people, or do you think it's mainly due to connections? — 一个人成功，是因为更努力，还是主要靠人脉？

112.q: If you were the owner of a business and one of your workers stole something from the business, would you give them a second chance, or would you dismiss them at once?
112.backbone: 虚拟条件句+并列+or并列选择疑问句
112.gloss: 如果你是老板，员工偷东西，你会再给机会还是立即解雇？
