chunks: If you were the owner of a business
and one of your workers stole something from the business,
would you give them a second chance,
or would you dismiss them at once?
112.rule: 「If+过去式虚拟条件」and并列新主语的过去式分句，主句「would you+动词A, or would you+动词B?」并列两种处理方式。
112.example: If you were the head of a school and one of your teachers lied about their qualifications, would you give them a warning, or would you dismiss them at once? — 如果你是校长，老师谎报资历，你会警告还是立即解雇？

113.q: If you rang somebody up when they were at work but they weren’t available immediately, would you wait, leave a message or call back later?
113.backbone: 混合虚拟条件句+让步转折+三选一疑问
113.gloss: 若你打电话找人但对方不在，你会等、留言还是回拨？
chunks: If you rang somebody up
when they were at work
but they weren’t available immediately,
would you wait, leave a message or call back later?
113.rule: If从句表条件，中间插when限定情境，but转折补充意外，主句用would you A, B or C三选一发问。
113.example: If you called a colleague when they were on holiday but they didn't answer straightaway, would you text, email or try again tomorrow? — 若你在同事度假时打电话给他们但他们没有立刻接，你会发短信、发邮件还是明天再试？

113.q: Do they collect money in the streets in your country for different causes, such as for the Red Cross, the poor etc.?
113.backbone: 一般疑问句+目的状语+举例结构
113.gloss: 你们国家街头是否为各种事业募捐，比如红十字会、穷人等？
chunks: Do they collect money in the streets in your country
for different causes,
such as for the Red Cross, the poor etc.?
113.rule: 一般疑问句后接for+目的状语说明用途，再用such as for...举例具体对象，构成"做X为了Y，比如Z"。
113.example: Do people donate clothes in the winter in your city for different groups, such as for the homeless, refugees etc.? — 你们城市冬天是否为不同群体捐衣物，比如流浪者、难民等？

113.q: If you kiss your mother hello, how many kisses do you give her – one, two or three?
113.backbone: 条件句+特殊疑问句+列举选项
113.gloss: 你吻母亲问好时，会亲几下——一、二还是三下？
chunks: If you kiss your mother hello,
how many kisses do you give her
– one, two or three?
113.rule: If条件句陈述习惯动作，主句用how many...do you...提问数量，句末破折号列出三个具体选项供选择。
113.example: If you shake hands hello, how long does the handshake last – a second, two seconds or longer? — 若你握手问好，握手会持续多久——一秒、两秒还是更久？

114.q: If a friend buys you a drink in a bar, do you normally insist on giving them the money or do you just buy them a drink the next time?
114.gloss: 朋友请你喝酒时，你会坚持给钱还是下次回请？
chunks: If a friend buys you a drink in a bar,
do you normally insist on giving them the money
or do you just buy them a drink the next time?
114.rule: If给出情境，主句用do you normally...or do you...并列两个完整疑问句，构成"这样还是那样"的选择提问。
114.example: If a colleague covers your shift at work, do you normally repay them with money or do you just cover their shift another time? — 若同事替你顶班，你通常会付钱还是改天替他顶班？

114.q: Do seasonal workers, such as waiters who work at seaside hotels in the summer, receive a wage or a salary?
114.backbone: 主语插入举例(such as)+关系从句+选择疑问
114.gloss: 季节工，比如夏天在海边旅馆打工的服务员，拿的是工资还是薪金？
chunks: Do seasonal workers,
such as waiters who work at seaside hotels in the summer,
receive a wage or a salary?
114.rule: 主语后用such as插入具体举例（可带定语从句），打断后再接谓语部分，构成"A或B"的选择疑问。
114.example: Do freelance workers, such as writers who work from home in the evenings, get paid by the hour or by the project? — 自由职业者，比如晚上在家工作的作家，是按小时算钱还是按项目算钱？

114.q: What would happen if you went on board ship to say goodbye to a friend and you remained on board after the ship had left port?
114.backbone: 虚拟条件句+过去完成时从句嵌套
114.gloss: 若你上船送别朋友却在开船后仍留在船上，会怎样？
chunks: What would happen
if you went on board ship to say goodbye to a friend
and you remained on board
after the ship had left port?
114.rule: What would happen if引出虚拟结果提问，条件从句用and并列两个动作，再用after+过去完成时从句补充时间背景。
114.example: What would happen if you fell asleep on a train and you woke up after the train had reached the last stop? — 若你在火车上睡着，醒来时火车已到终点站，会怎样？

115.q: When we have a preposition at the beginning of a relative clause, can we follow the preposition with the word “who”?
115.backbone: 时间状语从句+一般疑问句(语法讨论)
115.gloss: 关系从句开头有介词时，介词后能接who吗？
chunks: When we have a preposition at the beginning of a relative clause,
can we follow the preposition with the word “who”?
115.rule: When从句设定语法情境，主句用can we...with the word "X"提问某规则是否成立，用于讨论语法用法。
115.example: When we have an adjective before a noun, can we replace the adjective with the word "very much"? — 名词前有形容词时，能用very much替换这个形容词吗？

115.q: In normal spoken English, what do we say instead of “We need to contact the customer from whom she took the payment”?
115.backbone: 地点状语+特殊疑问句+引语替代结构
115.gloss: 日常口语中，这句正式说法通常怎么改说？
chunks: In normal spoken English,
what do we say
instead of “We need to contact the customer from whom she took the payment”?
115.rule: In+场景状语限定语域，主句用what do we say instead of "..."提问某表达的口语化替代说法。
115.example: In casual conversation, what do we say instead of "It is I who am responsible for this mistake"? — 日常口语中，这句正式说法通常怎么改说？

115.q: When you were a child, did you always like what you were given for your birthday?
115.backbone: 时间状语从句+宾语从句
115.gloss: 你小时候总喜欢生日收到的礼物吗？
chunks: When you were a child,
did you always like
what you were given for your birthday?
115.rule: When从句设定过去的时间背景，主句谓语后接what引导的宾语从句(被动语态)，询问对某事物的态度。
115.example: When you were at school, did you always finish what you were asked to do? — 你上学时总能完成被要求做的事吗？

116.q: If you were caught red-handed stealing something, would you declare yourself innocent before the judge when you appeared in court for your trial?
116.backbone: 虚拟条件句+时间状语从句嵌套
116.gloss: 若你偷东西被当场抓获，出庭受审时会在法官前称无罪吗？
chunks: If you were caught red-handed stealing something,
would you declare yourself innocent before the judge
when you appeared in court for your trial?
116.rule: If虚拟条件从句(被动语态)设定情境，主句would you...后接when+时间从句补充具体场合。
116.example: If you were stopped speeding by the police, would you admit your mistake at once when you spoke to the officer? — 若你因超速被警察拦下，跟警官说话时会立刻承认错误吗？

116.q: Why? If you were a great person, what kind of monument would you like the public to raise in your honour after you were dead?
116.backbone: 疑问词+虚拟条件句+特殊疑问句
116.gloss: 若你是伟人，希望死后公众为你立什么样的纪念碑？
chunks: Why?
If you were a great person,
what kind of monument would you like the public to raise
in your honour after you were dead?
116.rule: 独立Why?追问理由，If虚拟从句设定身份，主句用what kind of...would you like sb to do再接after从句补充时间。
116.example: Why? If you were a rich person, what kind of charity would you like your family to support after you were gone? — 若你是富人，希望你走后家人支持什么样的慈善事业？

116.q: How is it sometimes possible for a shop to make more profit if it lowers the prices of its goods?
116.backbone: it形式主语+不定式短语+条件从句
116.gloss: 商店降价后有时反而能赚更多利润，这是怎么回事？
chunks: How is it sometimes possible
for a shop to make more profit
if it lowers the prices of its goods?
116.rule: How is it possible for...to do构成it形式主语的特殊疑问句，句末if从句补充触发该结果的条件。
116.example: How is it sometimes possible for a company to save money if it raises the wages of its staff? — 公司给员工加薪后有时反而能省钱，这是怎么回事？

117.q: When a boy and a girl have a date, is it more common for the boy to pick the girl up at her house or to meet her somewhere in town?
117.backbone: 时间状语从句+形式主语+选择疑问
117.gloss: 男女约会时，通常是男生上门接还是约在市区见面？
chunks: When a boy and a girl have a date,
is it more common for the boy to pick the girl up at her house
or to meet her somewhere in town?
117.rule: When从句设定场景，主句用is it more common for sb to do A or to do B比较两种不定式做法的普遍程度。
117.example: When people move to a new city, is it more common for them to rent an apartment or to buy a house straightaway? — 人们搬到新城市时，通常是先租房还是直接买房？

117.q: If you bought some food in a supermarket and then discovered it was out of date, would you take it back?
117.backbone: 虚拟条件句+并列谓语+宾语从句
117.gloss: 若你买的食品过期了，会拿去退吗？
chunks: If you bought some food in a supermarket
and then discovered it was out of date,
would you take it back?
117.rule: If条件从句用and then并列两个动作，第二个动作带宾语从句说明发现的内容，主句简单疑问收尾。
117.example: If you bought a jacket online and then discovered it didn't fit, would you send it back? — 若你网购的外套发现不合身，会退货吗？

117.q: Are you the kind of person who likes to put his nose into things that don’t concern him?
117.backbone: 一般疑问句+双重定语从句嵌套
117.gloss: 你是那种爱管闲事的人吗？
chunks: Are you the kind of person
who likes to put his nose into things
that don’t concern him?
117.rule: Are you the kind of person who...构成身份类型提问，who从句内的宾语再接that引导的定语从句层层限定。
117.example: Are you the kind of person who prefers to keep secrets that other people have told him? — 你是那种喜欢保守别人告诉你的秘密的人吗？

118.q: Tell me the name of a famous person who you think is attractive even though they are not particularly beautiful or good-looking.
118.backbone: 祈使句+定语从句嵌套宾语从句+让步状语
118.gloss: 说出一位你觉得有魅力但外表并不算漂亮的名人。
chunks: Tell me the name of a famous person
who you think is attractive
even though they are not particularly beautiful or good-looking.
118.rule: 祈使句后接who引导定语从句(中间插入you think弱化)，再用even though让步从句形成对比转折。
118.example: Tell me the name of a book you feel is important even though it is not particularly popular or well-known. — 说出一本你觉得重要但并不算流行出名的书。

118.q: Do you think most people these days are too busy with their own lives to care about the rest of the people in the world?
118.gloss: 你觉得现在大多数人是否忙于自己生活而无暇关心世界其他人？
chunks: Do you think
most people these days are too busy with their own lives
to care about the rest of the people in the world?
118.rule: Do you think引导宾语从句，从句内用too+形容词+to do表示"太...而无法做某事"的结果。
118.example: Do you think most students these days are too focused on exams to enjoy learning for its own sake? — 你觉得现在大多数学生是否太专注考试而无法享受学习本身？

118.q: If you discovered rats in your house, would you consider using poison to kill them?
118.backbone: 虚拟条件句+动名词宾语+目的不定式
118.gloss: 若家里发现老鼠，你会考虑用毒药杀灭吗？
chunks: If you discovered rats in your house,
would you consider using poison
to kill them?
118.rule: If条件从句设定情境，主句用would you consider doing sth，再接不定式表达该动作的目的。
118.example: If you found mould in your bathroom, would you consider using bleach to remove it? — 若你在浴室发现霉菌，会考虑用漂白剂清除吗？

119.q: If you decided to set up a business in the place where you lived, what kind of business would you choose?
119.backbone: 虚拟条件句+地点定语从句+特殊疑问句
119.gloss: 若你在居住地开公司，会选择做什么样的生意？
chunks: If you decided to set up a business
in the place where you lived,
what kind of business would you choose?
119.rule: If条件从句内嵌where引导的地点定语从句限定范围，主句用what kind of...would you...提问具体选择。
119.example: If you decided to write a book about the city where you grew up, what kind of story would you tell? — 若你要写一本关于你成长城市的书，你会讲什么样的故事？

119.q: Why or why not? Where would you say was the most suitable place to go for a holiday if you wanted a complete rest?
119.backbone: 特殊疑问句嵌套从句+条件状语
119.gloss: 若想彻底休息，你会说哪里最适合度假？
chunks: Why or why not?
Where would you say
was the most suitable place to go for a holiday
if you wanted a complete rest?
119.rule: 独立追问理由，主句Where would you say后接省略that的宾语从句，句末if从句补充前提条件。
119.example: Why or why not? What would you say was the best way to learn a language if you had very little free time? — 若你几乎没空闲时间，你觉得学语言的最佳方式是什么？

119.q: What effect do you suppose it’d have on a perfect stranger if you went up to him in the street and hit him with a rolled-up newspaper?
119.backbone: 特殊疑问句嵌套虚拟条件句
119.gloss: 若你走上前用卷起的报纸打一个陌生人，会有什么效果？
chunks: What effect do you suppose it’d have on a perfect stranger
if you went up to him in the street
and hit him with a rolled-up newspaper?
119.rule: What...do you suppose it'd have on sb提问假设的影响，句末if虚拟从句(用and并列两个动作)交代具体行为。
119.example: What impression do you suppose it'd make on a new colleague if you turned up late on your first day and forgot their name? — 若你第一天上班迟到又忘了新同事的名字，会给对方留下什么印象？

120.q: If so, what? What do I mean if I say that I ought to have called my mother yesterday?
120.backbone: 条件疑问+特殊疑问句嵌套宾语从句
120.gloss: 若我说本该昨天给母亲打电话，是什么意思？
chunks: If so, what?
What do I mean
if I say
that I ought to have called my mother yesterday?
120.rule: 独立追问细节，主句What do I mean if I say that...用ought to have done表达"本该做却没做"的遗憾。
120.example: If so, why? What do I mean if I say that I should have finished the report last week? — 若我说本该上周完成报告，是什么意思？

120.q: If you were dying of hunger, would you share your last piece of food with another dying person?
120.backbone: 虚拟条件句(be dying进行时)
120.gloss: 若你快饿死了，会把最后一点食物分给另一个垂死的人吗？
chunks: If you were dying of hunger,
would you share your last piece of food
with another dying person?
120.rule: If虚拟条件从句用be dying of进行时强调极端濒临状态，主句would you...with...提问是否会分享/让步。
120.example: If you were drowning in the sea, would you grab the last life jacket before another drowning person? — 若你在海里快淹死了，会在另一个溺水者之前抢最后一件救生衣吗？

120.q: When your shoes are dirty, do you just clean them or do you polish them as well?
120.backbone: 时间状语从句+选择疑问句
120.gloss: 鞋脏了时，你只是擦干净还是也会打油？
chunks: When your shoes are dirty,
do you just clean them
or do you polish them as well?
120.rule: When从句设定情境，主句用do you just A or do you B as well对比"仅做基础动作"与"额外多做一步"。
120.example: When your car is dusty, do you just wash it or do you wax it as well? — 车脏了时，你只是洗车还是也会打蜡？

121.q: When you pay a visit to the doctor’s or dentist’s, do you generally have to fix an appointment before going or can you just go whenever you like?
121.backbone: 时间状语从句+选择疑问句
121.gloss: 看医生或牙医前一般要预约吗，还是随时可去？
chunks: When you pay a visit to the doctor’s or dentist’s,
do you generally have to fix an appointment before going
or can you just go whenever you like?
121.rule: When从句设情境，主句并列两个完整谓语(have to.../can just...)对比"需预约"与"随时可去"两种可能。
121.example: When you want to borrow a book from the library, do you generally have to show your card before leaving or can you just take it whenever you like? — 从图书馆借书时，通常要出示借书证才能带走，还是随时可拿？

121.q: If you went to a dinner party at somebody’s house and criticized their cooking, would you expect to be invited back again?
121.gloss: 若你在别人家做客却批评对方厨艺，还指望再被邀请吗？
chunks: If you went to a dinner party at somebody’s house
and criticized their cooking,
would you expect to be invited back again?
121.rule: If条件从句用and并列两个动作，主句would you expect to be done again用被动不定式表期待的结果。
121.example: If you borrowed a friend's car and returned it with an empty tank, would you expect to be lent it again? — 若你借朋友的车却油箱见底才还，还指望再被借车吗？

121.q: If I dared you to jump out of a first-floor window, would you do it?
121.backbone: 虚拟条件句(dare sb to do)
121.gloss: 若我怂恿你从二楼窗户跳下去，你会跳吗？
chunks: If I dared you to jump out of a first-floor window,
would you do it?
121.rule: If从句用dare sb to do表"怂恿某人做某事"，主句would you do it简洁反问是否会照做。
121.example: If I bet you couldn't eat ten burgers in an hour, would you try it? — 若我跟你打赌你一小时内吃不完十个汉堡，你会试试吗？

122.q: If we had £100 between us, and I took £75 and gave the balance to you, how much would you get?
122.backbone: 虚拟条件句+并列谓语+特殊疑问句
122.gloss: 若我们共有100英镑，我拿75英镑，剩下给你，你能得多少？
chunks: If we had £100 between us,
and I took £75
and gave the balance to you,
how much would you get?
122.rule: If虚拟条件从句用两个and连续并列三个动作交代分配过程，主句how much would you...提问结果数量。
122.example: If we shared 10 apples between us, and I took 6 and gave the rest to you, how many would you get? — 若我们共有10个苹果，我拿6个，剩下给你，你能得几个？

122.q: Name some things that people always pack in their suitcase when they go on holiday to a hot country.
122.backbone: 祈使句+定语从句+时间状语从句
122.gloss: 说出人们去炎热国家度假时总会打包的东西。
chunks: Name some things
that people always pack in their suitcase
when they go on holiday to a hot country.
122.rule: 祈使句Name some things that...用定语从句限定"事物"，再接when从句补充具体场景。
122.example: Name some things that people always take with them when they go camping in the mountains. — 说出人们去山里露营时总会带上的东西。

122.q: If you were offered five free hours of English lessons a day, could you afford the time to take them?
122.backbone: 虚拟条件句(被动)+不定式
122.gloss: 若每天有五小时免费英语课，你抽得出时间上吗？
chunks: If you were offered five free hours of English lessons a day,
could you afford the time
to take them?
122.rule: If虚拟条件从句用被动语态(be offered)设定获得的机会，主句could you afford the time to do询问是否腾得出时间。
122.example: If you were given three free tickets to a concert every month, could you afford the time to go? — 若每月免费获得三张音乐会门票，你抽得出时间去吗？

123.q: When a family moves to a new town, do you think it’s easier for the children to get used to everything than it is for the parents?
123.backbone: 时间状语从句+比较结构(easier...than)
123.gloss: 一家人搬到新城镇时，你觉得孩子适应起来比父母容易吗？
chunks: When a family moves to a new town,
do you think it’s easier for the children to get used to everything
than it is for the parents?
123.rule: When从句设情境，宾语从句用it's easier for A to do than it is for B比较两类人适应的难易程度。
123.example: When a country changes its currency, do you think it's harder for the elderly to adapt than it is for the young? — 一个国家更换货币时，你觉得老年人适应起来比年轻人难吗？

123.q: When we use a noun for the first time in a conversation, do we use the article “a” or “the”?
123.backbone: 时间状语从句+选择疑问句(语法)
123.gloss: 对话中首次提到名词时，用冠词a还是the？
chunks: When we use a noun for the first time in a conversation,
do we use the article “a” or “the”?
123.rule: When从句设定语法情境，主句do we use "A" or "B"提问该情境下该用哪个语法项。
123.example: When we describe an action that started in the past and continues now, do we use the present simple or the present perfect? — 描述始于过去且持续至今的动作时，该用一般现在时还是现在完成时？

123.q: In which situation do we use the definite article “the“ when we use a noun for the first time?
123.backbone: 特殊疑问句+时间状语从句
123.gloss: 首次提到名词时，什么情况下用定冠词the？
chunks: In which situation do we use the definite article “the“
when we use a noun for the first time?
123.rule: In which situation do we...提问适用条件，句末when从句补充限定的具体场景。
123.example: In which situation do we use the past perfect when we talk about two past actions? — 谈论两个过去动作时，什么情况下用过去完成时？

124.q: When you eat in a restaurant with a group of friends, do you think the bill should be split equally among everyone or do you think each person should pay for what they personally ordered?
124.backbone: 时间状语从句+选择疑问句(宾语从句嵌套)
124.gloss: 和朋友下馆子时，你觉得该平摊账单还是各付各的？
chunks: When you eat in a restaurant with a group of friends,
do you think the bill should be split equally among everyone
or do you think each person should pay for what they personally ordered?
124.rule: When从句设场景，主句用do you think...or do you think...并列两个完整宾语从句构成选择提问。
124.example: When you travel abroad with a group of colleagues, do you think everyone should follow the same schedule or do you think each person should plan their own day? — 和同事一起出国旅行时，你觉得该统一行程还是各自安排？

124.q: Now, as before, I will say a sentence and I want you to make a similar sentence with the word “so”: I never knew he had such a large quantity of money.
124.backbone: 指令句+并列谓语+待改写例句
124.gloss: 我说一句话，你用so改写：我从没想到他有这么多钱。
chunks: Now, as before, I will say a sentence
and I want you to make a similar sentence with the word “so”:
I never knew he had such a large quantity of money.
124.rule: 指令句用I will say...and I want you to...双动作说明改写任务，冒号后给出待用指定词改写的原句。
124.example: Now, as before, I will say a sentence and I want you to make a similar sentence with the word "such": He was extremely tired after the long journey. — 我说一句话，你用such改写：他长途旅行后累极了。

124.q: Now, I will say a sentence and I want you to make a similar sentence with the word “so”: I had no money for the bus and consequently I had to walk home.
124.backbone: 指令句+并列谓语+待改写例句(因果)
124.gloss: 我说一句话，你用so改写：我没钱坐车，只好走路回家。
chunks: Now, I will say a sentence
and I want you to make a similar sentence with the word “so”:
I had no money for the bus
and consequently I had to walk home.
124.rule: 指令句布置改写任务，待改写例句用and consequently连接原因与结果，供学生用指定词改写因果关系。
124.example: Now, I will say a sentence and I want you to make a similar sentence with the word "so": It started to rain heavily and consequently we had to cancel the picnic. — 我说一句话，你用so改写：下起大雨，我们只好取消野餐。

125.q: When a person retires from work after many years of employment in the same company, are they usually presented with a gift?
125.backbone: 时间状语从句(嵌套时间短语)+被动疑问句
125.gloss: 一个人在同一家公司工作多年后退休，通常会收到礼物吗？
chunks: When a person retires from work
after many years of employment in the same company,
are they usually presented with a gift?
125.rule: When从句内再用after+时间短语叠加时间背景，主句用被动语态are they presented with...提问惯例做法。
125.example: When a student graduates after four years of study at the same university, are they usually given a certificate? — 一个学生在同一所大学读完四年毕业后，通常会拿到证书吗？

125.q: If you parked a car outside your house and left it idle for a few months, would it get very dirty?
125.gloss: 若你把车停在家门外闲置几个月，会变得很脏吗？
chunks: If you parked a car outside your house
and left it idle for a few months,
would it get very dirty?
125.rule: If条件从句用and并列两个动作描述过程，主句would it get+形容词询问由此产生的状态变化。
125.example: If you left a bike outside in the garden and left it uncovered for a few weeks, would it get very rusty? — 若你把自行车放花园里不遮盖几周，会生锈很严重吗？

125.q: What do I mean if I say “The workers were idle because the machines had broken down“?
125.backbone: 特殊疑问句+条件从句+引语(过去完成时)
125.gloss: 若我说“机器坏了工人闲着”，是什么意思？
chunks: What do I mean
if I say
“The workers were idle because the machines had broken down“?
125.rule: What do I mean if I say "..."提问引语含义，引号内用because+过去完成时从句表达"先发生的原因"。
125.example: What do I mean if I say "The passengers were angry because the flight had been delayed"? — 若我说"乘客很生气因为航班延误了"，是什么意思？

126.q: Are you the kind of person who enjoys talking about the ideal, theoretical state of things, or do you consider such things a waste of time and prefer to talk about the actual state of things?
126.backbone: 一般疑问句+定语从句+选择疑问句(并列谓语)
126.gloss: 你是爱谈理论空想的人，还是觉得那是浪费时间只谈实际？
chunks: Are you the kind of person
who enjoys talking about the ideal, theoretical state of things,
or do you consider such things a waste of time
and prefer to talk about the actual state of things?
126.rule: 前半用who定语从句描述一种人，后半用or do you...and...并列谓语描述对立态度，构成两极对比选择。
126.example: Are you the kind of person who enjoys planning every detail in advance, or do you consider such planning unnecessary and prefer to improvise on the spot? — 你是喜欢提前规划每个细节的人，还是觉得没必要计划、更喜欢临场发挥？

126.q: 103) Tell me the difference between these two sentences: “When she writes the letter, she will drink a coffee“ and “When she has written the letter, she will drink a coffee“.
126.backbone: 编号习题+对比两个时间状语从句(一般现在vs现在完成)
126.gloss: 说明这两句时态区别：一般现在时vs现在完成时的时间状语从句。
chunks: 103) Tell me the difference between these two sentences:
“When she writes the letter, she will drink a coffee“
and “When she has written the letter, she will drink a coffee“.
126.rule: 祈使句后接两个引号例句作宾语，用相同主句只替换从句时态，让学习者辨析一般现在与现在完成的区别。
126.example: Tell me the difference between these two sentences: "If it rains, we will stay at home" and "If it has rained, the ground will be wet." — 说明这两句区别：if引导的一般现在时vs现在完成时条件句。

126.q: Tell me the difference between these two sentences: “When she writes the letter, she will drink a coffee“ and “When she has written the letter, she will drink a coffee“.
126.backbone: 对比两个时间状语从句(一般现在vs现在完成)
126.gloss: 说明这两句时态区别：一般现在时vs现在完成时的时间状语从句。
chunks: Tell me the difference between these two sentences:
“When she writes the letter, she will drink a coffee“
and “When she has written the letter, she will drink a coffee“.
126.rule: 祈使句后并列两个引号例句作比较宾语，仅改动从句时态，供学习者辨析一般现在与现在完成的用法差异。
126.example: Tell me the difference between these two sentences: "When he arrives, we will start the meeting" and "When he has arrived, we will start the meeting." — 说明这两句区别：一般现在时vs现在完成时的时间状语从句。

127.q: Supposing you could entertain a famous person at your house, either a great figure in history or someone alive today, who would you choose?
127.backbone: 虚拟语气(Supposing)+插入举例+疑问句
127.gloss: 假如你能邀请一位名人到家做客，历史伟人或当代名人，你选谁？
chunks: Supposing you could entertain a famous person at your house,
either a great figure in history or someone alive today,
who would you choose?
127.rule: Supposing代替If引出虚拟条件，从句后用either A or B插入具体选项范围，主句who would you choose聚焦选择。
127.example: Supposing you could learn any skill instantly, either a practical skill or an artistic one, what would you choose? — 假如你能瞬间学会任何技能，实用的或艺术的，你会选什么？

127.q: If a student gets an A grade in an exam, is that a good result or a bad result?
127.gloss: 学生考试得A，算好成绩还是差成绩？
chunks: If a student gets an A grade in an exam,
is that a good result or a bad result?
127.rule: If条件从句陈述事实性情境，主句is that a...or a...用同一名词搭配两个反义形容词构成简单选择疑问。
127.example: If a company loses money for three years in a row, is that a normal situation or a serious problem? — 若一家公司连续三年亏损，这算正常情况还是严重问题？

127.q: If you are not sure how to form the comparative and superlative of an adjective, what is it best to do?
127.backbone: 条件从句嵌套疑问宾语从句+特殊疑问句
127.gloss: 若不确定形容词比较级最高级怎么构成，最好怎么办？
chunks: If you are not sure
how to form the comparative and superlative of an adjective,
what is it best to do?
127.rule: If从句内嵌how to do构成的疑问宾语从句表达不确定的内容，主句what is it best to do用it形式主语提问最佳做法。
127.example: If you are not sure how to pronounce a new word, what is it best to do? — 若不确定新单词怎么发音，最好怎么办？

128.q: If a friend of yours wants to go to one cinema and you want to go to another, and you can’t agree about which to go to, what do you do?
128.backbone: 多重并列条件从句+特殊疑问句
128.gloss: 若你和朋友想看不同的电影又谈不拢，你会怎么办？
chunks: If a friend of yours wants to go to one cinema
and you want to go to another,
and you can’t agree about which to go to,
what do you do?
128.rule: If从句用两个and连续并列三个分句层层递进说明分歧过程，最后一句内嵌which to do疑问结构，主句what do you do收束。
128.example: If a colleague of yours wants to take one route to the airport and you want to take another, and you can't agree about which to take, what do you do? — 若你和同事想走不同路线去机场却谈不拢，你会怎么办？

128.q: If you held a dinner party and served food that had been cooked in a microwave, would it make a good impression on your guests?
128.backbone: 虚拟条件句+并列谓语+定语从句(过去完成被动)
128.gloss: 若宴客却端出微波炉加热的菜，会给客人留下好印象吗？
chunks: If you held a dinner party
and served food
that had been cooked in a microwave,
would it make a good impression on your guests?
128.rule: If从句用and并列两个动作，第二个动作后接that引导的定语从句(过去完成被动)说明来历，主句询问由此产生的印象。
128.example: If you organized a wedding and hired a band that had been booked at the last minute, would it make a good impression on your guests? — 若你办婚礼却临时找了个乐队，会给客人留下好印象吗？

128.q: Now that you are at this stage of your English studies, do you think you’d be able to travel abroad confident of making yourself understood in the language?
128.backbone: 原因状语从句(now that)+宾语从句
128.gloss: 到了目前的英语水平，你觉得出国旅行能自信地让人听懂你吗？
chunks: Now that you are at this stage of your English studies,
do you think you’d be able to travel abroad
confident of making yourself understood in the language?
128.rule: Now that引出已成立的原因状语从句，宾语从句谓语后接形容词短语confident of doing补充说明状态。
128.example: Now that you have finished this stage of your training, do you think you'd be able to work abroad confident of handling the job alone? — 完成这个阶段的培训后，你觉得能自信地独自出国工作吗？

129.q: If a fly was flying around your head while you were trying to fall asleep, would you get annoyed or would you be able to ignore it?
129.backbone: 混合条件句 + 选择疑问句
129.gloss: 如果入睡时有苍蝇绕着头飞，你会烦躁还是能无视它？
chunks: If a fly was flying around your head
while you were trying to fall asleep,
would you get annoyed
or would you be able to ignore it?
129.rule: If+过去进行时从句描述假设情境，while从句叠加同时发生的背景动作，主句用would...or would...构成二选一虚拟问句。
129.example: If a bee was buzzing around your face while you were trying to eat, would you swat it or would you just wait for it to fly away? — 如果吃饭时有蜜蜂在你脸边嗡嗡叫，你会拍打它还是等它自己飞走？

129.q: Is it the custom in your country for people to cross their fingers when they wish for something? If not, what do they do instead?
129.backbone: 是非疑问句 + If not追问句
129.gloss: 你们国家有许愿时交叉手指的习俗吗？没有的话会怎么做？
chunks: Is it the custom in your country
for people to cross their fingers
when they wish for something?
If not, what do they do instead?
129.rule: 用Is it the custom for sb to do...when...问某习俗是否存在，再用If not, what...instead追问替代做法。
129.example: Is it the custom in your country for people to shake hands when they meet for the first time? If not, what do they do instead? — 你们国家有初次见面握手的习俗吗？没有的话会怎么做？

129.q: Do you think a small man who was good at judo would be a match for a big man who knew how to box?
129.backbone: you think宾语从句 + 双重who定语从句对比
129.gloss: 你觉得柔道好的小个子能打得过会拳击的大个子吗？
chunks: Do you think a small man
who was good at judo
would be a match for a big man
who knew how to box?
129.rule: Do you think引导宾语从句，主语和比较对象各带一个who定语从句限定特征，用be a match for构成能力对比。
129.example: Do you think a young player who was fast on his feet would be a match for an experienced player who knew all the tricks? — 你觉得脚下快的年轻选手能打得过懂各种技巧的老手吗？

130.q: When your parents forbade you to do something when you were a small child, did the fact that it was forbidden sometimes just make you want to do it even more?
130.backbone: when从句叠加 + that同位语从句作主语
130.gloss: 小时候父母禁止你做某事时，被禁反而让你更想做吗？
chunks: When your parents forbade you to do something
when you were a small child,
did the fact that it was forbidden
sometimes just make you want to do it even more?
130.rule: 两个when从句叠加限定情境，主句用did the fact that+同位语从句作主语，接make sb do更甚的结果。
130.example: When your teacher told you not to talk when you were sitting an exam, did the fact that it was forbidden sometimes just make you want to whisper even more? — 考试时老师不许说话，被禁反而让你更想小声说话吗？

130.q: If I asked you which of two things you wanted, and the choice was of no importance to you, what would you reply?
130.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + 特殊疑问句（宾语从句嵌套）
130.gloss: 如果我问你两者选哪个而你无所谓，你会怎么回答？
chunks: If I asked you which of two things you wanted,
and the choice was of no importance to you,
what would you reply?
130.rule: 虚拟条件句If I asked you接特殊疑问词引导的宾语从句，并列一个补充条件，主句用what would you...提问。
130.example: If I asked you which of two films you preferred, and the decision was entirely up to you, what would you choose? — 如果我问你两部电影更喜欢哪部而选择完全由你定，你会选哪个？

130.q: What’s the maximum number of people you could invite to a party if you held it in the building where you live?
130.backbone: 特殊疑问句 + if条件从句 + where定语从句嵌套
130.gloss: 如果派对办在你住的楼里，最多能请多少人？
chunks: What’s the maximum number of people
you could invite to a party
if you held it in the building where you live?
130.rule: 特殊疑问句What's the maximum number of...you could do接if条件从句，从句末尾用where定语从句限定地点。
130.example: What's the maximum number of guests you could seat at dinner if you held it in the room where you usually eat? — 如果晚宴办在你平时吃饭的房间里，最多能坐下多少客人？

131.q: When you ask a friend what they did last weekend, for example, do you expect them to go into great detail about everything that happened or just give you the basic facts?
131.backbone: when从句 + 插入语 + 选择疑问句
131.gloss: 问朋友周末做了什么时，你想听细节还是只要大概？
chunks: When you ask a friend what they did last weekend, for example,
do you expect them to go into great detail about everything that happened
or just give you the basic facts?
131.rule: When从句内嵌一个疑问词宾语从句作举例情境，插入for example后，主句用do you expect...to A or B二选一提问。
131.example: When you ask a colleague what they did on their day off, for example, do you expect them to explain every detail or just give a quick summary? — 问同事休息日做了什么时，你想听全部细节还是简单概括？

131.q: When the police are searching for evidence at the scene of a crime, do they have to pay attention to very small details?
131.backbone: when条件句 + 是非疑问句
131.gloss: 警察在犯罪现场找证据时需要留意很小的细节吗？
chunks: When the police are searching for evidence at the scene of a crime,
do they have to pay attention to very small details?
131.rule: When从句用现在进行时描绘场景，主句用do/does...have to...构成是非疑问，询问该情境下的必要性。
131.example: When doctors are examining a patient in the emergency room, do they have to make decisions very quickly? — 医生在急诊室给病人检查时需要很快做决定吗？

131.q: Why do people have a much greater chance of living to a much greater age these days than they did in the old days?
131.backbone: why特殊疑问句 + 比较级than结构
131.gloss: 为什么现在人比过去更有可能活到更大年纪？
chunks: Why do people have a much greater chance of living to a much greater age
these days
than they did in the old days?
131.rule: Why特殊疑问句陈述现今程度更高的事实，用than they did in the old days构成今昔比较从句。
131.example: Why do people have a much easier way of finding information these days than they did in the old days? — 为什么现在人比过去更容易获取信息？

132.q: If I said to you that, according to the newspapers this morning, life had been discovered on another planet, would you believe me?
132.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + that宾语从句插入状语
132.gloss: 如果我说今早报纸称外星发现生命，你会信吗？
chunks: If I said to you
that, according to the newspapers this morning,
life had been discovered on another planet,
would you believe me?
132.rule: 虚拟条件句If I said to you that接宾语从句，从句中插入according to X表明信息来源，主句would you believe me。
132.example: If I told you that, according to the scientists on TV last night, a new virus had been discovered in the ocean, would you believe me? — 如果我说昨晚电视上科学家称海洋发现新病毒，你会信吗？

132.q: When browsing on the internet, do you ever follow so many links that you forget what you were originally doing?
132.backbone: 分词状语 + so...that结果状语从句
132.gloss: 上网时你会点太多链接以致忘了本来要做什么吗？
chunks: When browsing on the internet,
do you ever follow so many links
that you forget what you were originally doing?
132.rule: When加分词短语作时间状语描述背景动作，主句用so...that结构表达程度导致的具体结果。
132.example: When shopping online, do you ever click so many product pages that you forget what you originally wanted to buy? — 网购时你会点太多商品页面以致忘了本来想买什么吗？

132.q: If you have a car accident and make a claim on your insurance, do you have to give a detailed explanation of what happened?
132.backbone: 条件句（并列谓语）+ 是非疑问句
132.gloss: 出车祸向保险索赔时需要详细说明经过吗？
chunks: If you have a car accident
and make a claim on your insurance,
do you have to give a detailed explanation
of what happened?
132.rule: if条件句用并列谓语描述连续动作，主句do you have to...询问随之而来的义务。
132.example: If you break something at work and report it to your manager, do you have to give a written explanation of what happened? — 上班弄坏东西并报告经理后，需要写书面说明经过吗？

133.q: Give me an example of “wish” used to communicate the idea that we want something good to happen to somebody.
133.backbone: 祈使句 + 过去分词短语 + that同位语从句
133.gloss: 举例说明wish用来表达希望别人有好事发生。
chunks: Give me an example of “wish”
used to communicate the idea
that we want something good to happen to somebody.
133.rule: 祈使句Give me an example of X接过去分词短语作后置定语，再用that同位语从句说明该用法表达的含义。
133.example: Give me an example of “hope” used to communicate the idea that we expect something good will happen in the future. — 举例说明hope用来表达期望未来有好事发生。

133.q: If you have a headache, what do you think is the best way to ease the pain?
133.backbone: 条件句 + 疑问句嵌套宾语从句
133.gloss: 如果你头痛，你觉得最好的缓解方法是什么？
chunks: If you have a headache,
what do you think
is the best way to ease the pain?
133.rule: if条件句后接特殊疑问句，其中do you think插入主谓之间，what兼作后面从句的主语。
133.example: If you have trouble sleeping, what do you think is the best way to relax before bed? — 如果你失眠，你觉得睡前放松的最好办法是什么？

133.q: If a thief robbed you of something in the street and ran away, what would you do?
133.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + 特殊疑问句
133.gloss: 如果小偷在街上抢了你东西就跑，你会怎么做？
chunks: If a thief robbed you of something in the street
and ran away,
what would you do?
133.rule: 虚拟条件句用并列过去式动词描述连续事件，主句what would you do提问应对方式。
133.example: If a stranger knocked on your door late at night and refused to say who they were, what would you do? — 如果深夜有陌生人敲门却不肯说自己是谁，你会怎么做？

134.q: Do you think that success in life (like making a lot of money) is largely a matter of luck, or do you think certain qualities are required which are more important than luck?
134.backbone: 选择疑问句 + that宾语从句 + which定语从句
134.gloss: 你认为人生成功靠运气，还是需要比运气更重要的素质？
chunks: Do you think that success in life (like making a lot of money) is largely a matter of luck,
or do you think certain qualities are required
which are more important than luck?
134.rule: 选择疑问句并列两个do you think + that从句，第二个从句末尾加which定语从句补充说明。
134.example: Do you think that doing well at school (like getting top grades) is largely a matter of intelligence, or do you think certain habits are required which are more important than intelligence? — 你认为学业出色主要靠天赋，还是需要比天赋更重要的习惯？

134.q: If you had bought a ticket for a music festival but then the event was cancelled at the last moment on account of bad weather, do you think you’d be able to get a refund?
134.backbone: 过去虚拟条件句（had done）+ 宾语从句嵌套疑问
134.gloss: 如果你买了音乐节票却因天气取消，你觉得能退款吗？
chunks: If you had bought a ticket for a music festival
but then the event was cancelled at the last moment
on account of bad weather,
do you think you’d be able to get a refund?
134.rule: 过去虚拟条件句用had done描述已发生的假设，but then接被动态补充转折结果，主句用do you think you'd...追问推测。
134.example: If you had booked a flight for a trip abroad but then the flight was cancelled at the last minute on account of a strike, do you think you'd be able to get a refund? — 如果你订了出国机票却因罢工临时取消，你觉得能退款吗？

134.q: When a member of the public is killed by a police officer, do you think there ought to be an official inquiry into the death?
134.backbone: when被动从句 + 插入疑问句
134.gloss: 平民被警察打死时，你觉得应该有官方调查吗？
chunks: When a member of the public is killed by a police officer,
do you think
there ought to be an official inquiry into the death?
134.rule: When从句用被动语态描述事件，主句do you think there ought to be...询问是否应有相应的正式处理。
134.example: When a patient is harmed by a doctor's mistake, do you think there ought to be an official investigation into the case? — 病人因医生失误受害时，你觉得应该有官方调查吗？

135.q: What do we say when we are trying to think of a word or a name that we know well, but we cannot remember it immediately?
135.backbone: 特殊疑问句 + when从句 + 定语从句
135.gloss: 想不起熟悉的词或名字时，我们会怎么说？
chunks: What do we say
when we are trying to think of a word or a name
that we know well,
but we cannot remember it immediately?
135.rule: 特殊疑问句What do we say when引导情境从句，从句内嵌that定语从句并用but并列转折补充细节。
135.example: What do we say when we are trying to recall a place or a name that we visited once, but we cannot picture it clearly? — 想不起只去过一次却记不清的地方或名字时，我们会怎么说？

135.q: When you’re buying something like a new phone or watch, do you have trouble making up your mind which one to buy?
135.backbone: when状语从句 + 是非疑问句嵌套疑问代词从句
135.gloss: 买新手机或手表时，你会纠结选哪个吗？
chunks: When you’re buying something like a new phone or watch,
do you have trouble making up your mind
which one to buy?
135.rule: When从句用like举例说明情境，主句have trouble making up your mind后接疑问词+不定式的嵌套结构。
135.example: When you're choosing something like a restaurant or a movie, do you have trouble making up your mind which one to pick? — 挑餐厅或电影这类事时，你会纠结选哪个吗？

135.q: When considering the price of a meal in a restaurant, do you take into account such things as the service charge and the waiter’s tip?
135.backbone: 分词状语 + 是非疑问句（such as举例）
135.gloss: 算餐厅账单时你会考虑服务费和小费吗？
chunks: When considering the price of a meal in a restaurant,
do you take into account
such things as the service charge and the waiter’s tip?
135.rule: When加分词短语作时间状语，主句用such things as X and Y列举具体考虑因素。
135.example: When planning a long trip abroad, do you take into account such things as travel insurance and visa requirements? — 计划长途出国旅行时，你会考虑旅游保险和签证要求这类事吗？

136.q: If an art dealer sold you a painting and then you realized that you’d been deceived about the value of the painting, would you go back to the dealer and complain?
136.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + that宾语从句（被动完成态）
136.gloss: 如果画商骗了你画的价值，你会回去投诉吗？
chunks: If an art dealer sold you a painting
and then you realized
that you’d been deceived about the value of the painting,
would you go back to the dealer and complain?
136.rule: 虚拟条件句用and then连接两个先后动作，第二个动作接that从句(过去完成被动)说明发现的事实，主句用并列动词提问应对。
136.example: If a mechanic repaired your car and then you realized that you'd been overcharged for the parts, would you go back to the garage and complain? — 如果修车师傅修完车后你发现零件被多收了钱，你会回去投诉吗？

136.q: When you happen to see someone you know on the street but it’s someone that you don’t particularly want to speak to, what do you do?
136.backbone: when从句转折 + that定语从句
136.gloss: 在街上碰到不太想搭话的熟人时，你会怎么做？
chunks: When you happen to see someone you know on the street
but it’s someone
that you don’t particularly want to speak to,
what do you do?
136.rule: When从句陈述情境，用but引出转折从句并内嵌that定语从句补充限定，主句what do you do提问反应。
136.example: When you happen to bump into someone you used to date but it's someone that you don't particularly want to talk about the past with, what do you do? — 偶遇不太想聊过去的前任时，你会怎么做？

136.q: Which is heavier: a bar of gold or a bar of iron (if, of course, they are the same size)?
136.backbone: 选择疑问句 + 插入条件状语（假设同尺寸）
136.gloss: 假设体积相同，一块金子和一块铁哪个更重？
chunks: Which is heavier:
a bar of gold or a bar of iron
(if, of course, they are the same size)?
136.rule: 选择疑问句用冒号列出两个比较对象，括号内插入if条件从句补充说明比较成立的前提条件。
136.example: Which is faster: a modern electric car or a modern petrol car (if, of course, they have the same amount of power)? — 假设动力相同，一辆现代电车和现代汽油车哪个更快？

137.q: If you developed an ache in your lower back that would not go away, would you ignore it or go to the doctor?
137.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + that定语从句 + 选择疑问
137.gloss: 如果你腰痛一直不好，你会忽视还是去看医生？
chunks: If you developed an ache in your lower back
that would not go away,
would you ignore it
or go to the doctor?
137.rule: 虚拟条件句的宾语后接that定语从句进一步限定，主句用would you A or B构成选择疑问。

137.q: Do you agree that the instruction booklets that come with electrical products sometimes contain so much detail that they simply cause confusion?
137.backbone: that从句嵌套定语从句 + so...that结果状语
137.gloss: 你同意电器说明书有时细节太多反而让人困惑吗？
chunks: Do you agree
that the instruction booklets
that come with electrical products
sometimes contain so much detail
that they simply cause confusion?

137.example: Do you agree that the safety manuals that come with new appliances sometimes contain so many warnings that people simply stop reading them? — 你同意新电器说明书有时警告太多以致人们干脆不看了吗？

137.q: If you interfered in a private matter that had nothing to do with you, what might somebody say to you?
137.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + that定语从句 + 特殊疑问句
137.gloss: 如果你插手与你无关的私事，别人可能会说什么？

that had nothing to do with you,
what might somebody say to you?

137.example: If you gave advice about a decision that had nothing to do with you, what might somebody say to you? — 如果你对与你无关的决定指手画脚，别人可能会说什么？

138.q: If somebody you fancied started going out with a friend of yours, would you feel jealous, or would you just be happy for your friend?
138.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + 选择疑问句
138.gloss: 如果喜欢的人和你朋友交往了，你会嫉妒还是替朋友高兴？

would you feel jealous,
or would you just be happy for your friend?

138.q: If you were fortunate enough to win £5 million in the lottery, how much of it would you give to the other members of your family?

how much of it
would you give to the other members of your family?

138.q: Do you carry an umbrella in case it rains, or are you the kind of person who prefers to run the risk of it raining?

or are you the kind of person
who prefers to run the risk of it raining?

or do someone a favour,
and they say “Thank you“,
what can we reply?

do you ever just leave your clothes in a heap on the floor
instead of putting them away?

chunks: When you have an insect bite
that’s itching a lot,
do you scratch it
or try to leave it alone?
139.rule: When从句宾语接that定语从句补充说明状态，主句用do you A or try to B构成应对方式的选择疑问。
139.example: When you have a small cut that's bleeding a little, do you cover it up or just let it heal in the open air? — 有个流点血的小伤口时，你会包起来还是让它露着自愈？

and what would you do,
if all your plans for the future were wrecked
through some accident or some piece of misfortune?

140.q: When do we use “some“, “somebody“ and “something“ in questions instead of the usual “any“, “anybody“ and “anything“?

chunks: When do we use “some“, “somebody“ and “something“
in questions
instead of the usual “any“, “anybody“ and “anything“?

140.q: At about what age do you feel that a person should be considered by law to be responsible for their own actions?

140.gloss: 你觉得人大概到几岁法律上要为自己行为负责？
chunks: At about what age
do you feel
that a person should be considered by law
to be responsible for their own actions?
140.rule: 介词短语At about what age提前构成疑问句开头，主句do you feel that接宾语从句，从句用被动语态+不定式表达法律规定。

141.q: Is there any job you could think of that you would like to do, not for the money, but for the mere honour that goes with the job?

141.gloss: 有没有你愿意做、只为荣誉而非金钱的工作？
chunks: Is there any job you could think of
that you would like to do,
not for the money,
but for the mere honour that goes with the job?
141.rule: 是非疑问句Is there any...you could think of接that定语从句，用not...but...对比做某事的真正动机。

141.q: If you arrived at a railway station with a heavy suitcase, would you ask a porter to help you with it or would you struggle with it yourself?

chunks: If you arrived at a railway station with a heavy suitcase,
would you ask a porter to help you with it
or would you struggle with it yourself?
141.rule: 虚拟条件句用with短语补充伴随状态，主句would you A or would you B构成应对方式的选择疑问。

141.q: What problem might you have if you took a faulty product back to a shop but didn’t have the receipt to prove where you bought it anymore?

141.gloss: 如果退货没小票证明购买地，你可能会遇到什么问题？
chunks: What problem might you have
if you took a faulty product back to a shop
but didn’t have the receipt
to prove where you bought it anymore?

142.q: And what do you say if, in passing, you accidentally step on the foot of one of the two people who are speaking?

142.gloss: 如果你经过时不小心踩到正在说话的人的脚，你会说什么？
chunks: And what do you say
if, in passing,
you accidentally step on the foot of one of the two people
who are speaking?

142.example: And what do you say if, by mistake, you accidentally sit in the seat of one of the two people who are chatting nearby? — 如果你不小心坐了正在聊天的两人中一人的座位，你会说什么？

142.q: Do you believe that there are people in the world who can put a magic charm on other people?
142.backbone: 是非疑问句 + that宾语从句 + who定语从句
142.gloss: 你相信世上有人能对别人施魔咒吗？
chunks: Do you believe
that there are people in the world
who can put a magic charm on other people?

142.q: What do you say when you want to pass between two people who are speaking to each other?
