142.gloss: 要从正说话的两人中间穿过时，你会说什么？
chunks: What do you say
when you want to pass between two people
who are speaking to each other?
142.rule: 特殊疑问句接when从句说明具体意图和场景，末尾用who定语从句限定该情境涉及的对象。
142.example: What do you say when you want to interrupt two people who are arguing with each other? — 想打断正在争吵的两人时，你会说什么？

143.q: If you’re in a restaurant but you only want a two-course meal, which do you normally have: a starter and main course, or a main course and dessert?
143.backbone: 条件句 + 选择疑问句（冒号列举选项）
143.gloss: 只吃两道菜时，你通常选前菜+主菜还是主菜+甜点？
chunks: If you’re in a restaurant
but you only want a two-course meal,
which do you normally have:
a starter and main course,
or a main course and dessert?
143.rule: if条件句用but转折限定情境，主句which do you normally have后用冒号列出两组具体选项供选择。
143.example: If you're at a café but you only want a quick snack, which do you normally order: a sandwich and coffee, or a pastry and juice? — 只想简单吃点时，你通常点三明治加咖啡，还是糕点加果汁？

143.q: Do you prefer to eat a substantial breakfast like bacon and eggs in the morning, or do you prefer something light such as cereal and toast?
143.backbone: 选择疑问句（or并列）+ 举例说明
143.gloss: 你早餐喜欢培根鸡蛋这类丰盛的，还是麦片吐司这类清淡的？
chunks: Do you prefer to eat a substantial breakfast like bacon and eggs in the morning,
or do you prefer something light
such as cereal and toast?
143.rule: 选择疑问句并列两个do you prefer，各自用like/such as列举具体例子说明偏好类型。
143.example: Do you prefer to have a big dinner like steak and potatoes in the evening, or do you prefer something simple such as soup and bread? — 你晚餐喜欢牛排土豆这类丰盛的，还是汤和面包这类简单的？

143.q: Would you show any resistance if a policeman tried to arrest you for a crime that you did not commit?
143.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + that定语从句
143.gloss: 如果警察因你没犯的罪要抓你，你会反抗吗？
chunks: Would you show any resistance
if a policeman tried to arrest you for a crime
that you did not commit?
143.rule: 主句前置疑问，if虚拟条件从句末尾用that定语从句限定所涉事项，强调事实与指控的落差。
143.example: Would you take legal action if a company tried to charge you for a service that you did not use? — 如果公司想向你收取你没用过的服务费，你会走法律途径吗？

144.q: If a dog sits looking at you while you’re eating a meal, do you feed it while you’re eating, or do you leave a little bit of food on your plate and feed it to the dog after you’ve finished?
144.backbone: 条件句 + 复合选择疑问句（while从句重复）
144.gloss: 狗吃饭时盯着你看，你会边吃边喂，还是吃完再喂剩饭？
chunks: If a dog sits looking at you
while you’re eating a meal,
do you feed it while you’re eating,
or do you leave a little bit of food on your plate
and feed it to the dog after you’ve finished?
144.rule: if从句叠加while从句设定背景，选择疑问句两个分支分别重复while从句、或用and并列动作并加after从句。
144.example: If a cat sits watching you while you're cooking dinner, do you feed it while you're cooking, or do you save a little bit of food on a plate and give it to the cat after you've finished? — 猫做饭时盯着你看，你会边做边喂，还是做完再喂剩菜？

144.q: When you go on holiday, do you prefer to let a travel agency deal with everything for you, or do you prefer to make all your arrangements yourself?
144.backbone: when从句 + 选择疑问句（let vs make对比）
144.gloss: 度假时你喜欢交给旅行社安排，还是自己一手包办？
chunks: When you go on holiday,
do you prefer to let a travel agency deal with everything for you,
or do you prefer to make all your arrangements yourself?
144.rule: When从句设定情境，选择疑问句对比let sb do sth（假手他人）与do sth yourself（亲力亲为）两种方式。
144.example: When you move to a new house, do you prefer to let professional movers handle everything for you, or do you prefer to do all the packing yourself? — 搬家时你喜欢交给专业搬家公司，还是自己一手打包？

144.q: When you were a child and your parents forbade you to do something, did you use to go ahead and do it just the same?
144.backbone: when从句（并列）+ used to一般过去疑问句
144.gloss: 小时候父母禁止的事，你会照样偷偷去做吗？
chunks: When you were a child
and your parents forbade you to do something,
did you use to go ahead
and do it just the same?
144.rule: When从句用and并列两个背景条件，主句used to+并列动词表达过去反复出现的习惯性反应。
144.example: When you were a student and your teacher told you not to use your phone in class, did you use to ignore the rule and do it anyway? — 上学时老师不让上课用手机，你会照样无视规定用吗？

145.q: At a party, do you think it’s better to let everyone help themselves to the food, or do you think it’s better for them to be served by someone?
145.backbone: 选择疑问句：两种聚会用餐方式对比
145.gloss: 问：聚会上更好的做法是自助取食还是有人服务？
chunks: At a party,
do you think it’s better to let everyone help themselves to the food,
or do you think it’s better for them to be served by someone?
145.rule: 状语点明场景，接 do you think it's better to do A, or ... better for sb to do B？对比两种做法孰优。
145.example: At school, do you think it’s better to let students choose their own subjects, or do you think it’s better for teachers to decide for them? — 在学校，该让学生自选科目，还是该由老师替他们决定？

145.q: When a man commits murder and the law cannot prove he did it, even though everyone is convinced he did, what happens?
145.backbone: when从句+让步分句(even though)+特殊疑问句
145.gloss: 问：证据不足时，即使大家都确信他有罪，会怎样？
chunks: When a man commits murder and the law cannot prove he did it,
even though everyone is convinced he did,
what happens?
145.rule: When 从句给出情景，中间插入 even though... 表让步对比，主句用 what happens? 追问最终结果。
145.example: When a student cheats in an exam and the teacher cannot catch them, even though everyone suspects they did, what happens? — 学生作弊却抓不到证据，即使大家怀疑，会怎样？

145.q: If a criminal admits their guilt before any trial takes place, is their punishment often reduced by the judge?
145.backbone: 真实条件句+一般疑问句(被动语态)
145.gloss: 问：罪犯审判前认罪，法官常会减刑吗？
chunks: If a criminal admits their guilt before any trial takes place,
is their punishment often reduced by the judge?
145.rule: If 条件句设前提(可嵌 before 时间从句)，主句用 is/are + 主语 + 过去分词构成被动语态提问结果。
145.example: If a witness comes forward before the police finish their investigation, is the case usually solved more quickly? — 若证人在结案前主动出面，案子通常会更快侦破吗？

146.q: Now, I will give you a sentence, and you say a sentence with the same meaning, but with a modal: She runs every day, so I’m sure she’s fit.
146.backbone: 指令+例句：用情态动词改写同义句
146.gloss: 给出例句，要求用情态动词改写为同义句
chunks: Now, I will give you a sentence,
and you say a sentence with the same meaning,
but with a modal:
She runs every day,
so I’m sure she’s fit.
146.rule: 指令模板：I will give you a sentence, and you say one with the same meaning, but with [语法点]，后接例句要求改写。
146.example: Now, I will give you a sentence, and you say a sentence with the same meaning, but in the passive voice: Someone stole my bike, so I had to walk home. — 给出例句，要求改写为被动语态的同义句。

146.q: When we use modals in this way, what do we do when we’re talking about something that happened in the past?
146.backbone: when从句+特殊疑问句(内嵌when从句)
146.gloss: 问：这样用情态动词谈过去的事该怎么做？
chunks: When we use modals in this way,
what do we do
when we’re talking about something that happened in the past?
146.rule: When 从句交代规则背景，主句 what do we do 后再接 when 从句限定具体情境，构成背景+做法+限定三层问句。
146.example: When we use phrasal verbs in this way, what do we do when we’re talking about something that happens repeatedly? — 这样用短语动词时，谈反复发生的事该怎么处理？

146.q: At the cinema, when someone passes in front of the projector and cuts the beam of light, what do we see appear on the screen?
146.backbone: 地点状语+when从句+特殊疑问句(see...appear)
146.gloss: 问：有人挡住放映光束时，银幕上会看到什么？
chunks: At the cinema,
when someone passes in front of the projector and cuts the beam of light,
what do we see appear on the screen?
146.rule: 地点状语+when从句铺垫情景，主句用 what do we see + 动词原形? 表'看到某物做某事'的感官动词结构。
146.example: In the kitchen, when someone opens the oven door too fast, what do we see happen to the steam inside? — 猛地打开烤箱门时，会看到里面的蒸汽发生什么？

147.q: When people go and live in another country because of their job, do they sometimes feel lonely at first?
147.backbone: when从句(含原因状语)+一般疑问句
147.gloss: 问：因工作移居他国的人一开始会孤独吗？
chunks: When people go and live in another country because of their job,
do they sometimes feel lonely at first?
147.rule: When 从句描述情景(可加 because of 表原因)，主句用 do/does + 主语 + 动词 提问是否出现某种感受。
147.example: When people start a new job in a big company, do they sometimes feel overwhelmed at first? — 刚到大公司入职的人，一开始会感到不知所措吗？

147.q: If you felt that someone was trying to take advantage of you, would you say anything to them?
147.backbone: 第二条件句(虚拟)：若感到被利用会怎样
147.gloss: 问：若觉得有人想占你便宜，你会说什么吗？
chunks: If you felt that someone was trying to take advantage of you,
would you say anything to them?
147.rule: If + 主语 + 过去式(虚拟设想)，主句 would + 主语 + 动词原形? 表达假设情境下的反应。
147.example: If you felt that a friend was avoiding you on purpose, would you ask them why? — 若你觉得朋友故意躲着你，你会去问原因吗？

147.q: If you have a problem with your central heating, who do you need to hire to fix it?
147.backbone: 真实条件句+特殊疑问句(需雇谁)
147.gloss: 问：暖气出问题该雇谁来修？
chunks: If you have a problem with your central heating,
who do you need to hire to fix it?
147.rule: If + 现在时描述真实情况，主句用特殊疑问词(如 who) + do you need to do 提问应采取的行动。
147.example: If you have a leak in your roof, who do you need to call to repair it? — 如果屋顶漏水，你需要叫谁来修？

148.q: If you went camping, would you prefer your tent to be on a campsite with proper facilities, or would you prefer to make your own camp away from everyone else?
148.backbone: 第二条件句+选择疑问句(两种露营偏好)
148.gloss: 问：露营时偏好正规营地还是自己扎营？
chunks: If you went camping,
would you prefer your tent to be on a campsite with proper facilities,
or would you prefer to make your own camp away from everyone else?
148.rule: If + 过去式设想情境，接 would you prefer A, or would you prefer B? 并列两个 prefer 结构对比两种选择。
148.example: If you went on holiday, would you prefer to stay in a busy city with lots to do, or would you prefer to relax somewhere quiet by the sea? — 若去度假，你想去热闹城市还是安静海边？

148.q: If you bought a set of knives, forks and spoons, how many of each would you expect it to contain?
148.backbone: 第二条件句+特殊疑问句(数量how many)
148.gloss: 问：若买一套餐具，各种预期各有几件？
chunks: If you bought a set of knives, forks and spoons,
how many of each would you expect it to contain?
148.rule: If + 过去式设想购买/拥有某物，主句 how many of each would you expect it to V? 询问数量预期。
148.example: If you bought a box of assorted chocolates, how many different flavours would you expect it to contain? — 若买一盒什锦巧克力，你预期会有几种口味？

148.q: If your school report is (or was) good (or bad), what do (or did) your parents say?
148.backbone: 条件句(现在/过去并列选项)+特殊疑问句
148.gloss: 问：成绩单好坏时，父母会说什么？
chunks: If your school report is (or was) good (or bad),
what do (or did) your parents say?
148.rule: If 从句与主句都用(X或Y)括注并列现在式/过去式，一套问句同时覆盖现在和过去两种对应情境。
148.example: If your exam result is (or was) high (or low), how do (or did) your teachers react? — 考试成绩好坏(现在或过去)，老师会有何反应？

149.q: If you went to the cinema and bought a ticket, some popcorn and a drink, how much would you expect to pay for the lot?
149.backbone: 第二条件句+特殊疑问句(花费how much)
149.gloss: 问：看电影买票、爆米花和饮料共要花多少钱？
chunks: If you went to the cinema and bought a ticket, some popcorn and a drink,
how much would you expect to pay for the lot?
149.rule: If + 过去式并列多个动作列出购买清单，主句 how much would you expect to pay for the lot? 询问总花费。
149.example: If you went to the supermarket and bought bread, milk and some fruit, how much would you expect to pay for the lot? — 若去超市买面包、牛奶和水果，总共要多少钱？

149.q: If you were stuck in a very bad traffic jam, would you turn your car engine off to save petrol?
149.backbone: 第二条件句+一般疑问句(是否关引擎省油)
149.gloss: 问：堵车严重时你会关引擎省油吗？
chunks: If you were stuck in a very bad traffic jam,
would you turn your car engine off to save petrol?
149.rule: If + 过去式设想困境，主句 would you + 动词 + to + 动词(目的状语) 询问是否为达成目的而采取该行动。
149.example: If you were stuck waiting for a delayed flight, would you go and find a quiet corner to get some rest? — 若航班延误久等，你会找个安静角落休息吗？

149.q: If we want to recycle our rubbish, do we have to sort it into different types?
149.backbone: 真实条件句+一般疑问句(是否需要分类)
149.gloss: 问：要回收垃圾的话，需要分类吗？
chunks: If we want to recycle our rubbish,
do we have to sort it into different types?
149.rule: If + 现在时描述真实目标，主句 do we have to + 动词? 询问为达成该目标是否必须采取某步骤。
149.example: If we want to save energy at home, do we have to unplug appliances when they’re not in use? — 若想在家省电，是不是不用的电器都得拔插头？

150.q: When we decide how much time we need to travel from one place to another, should we always make allowances for the possibility of traffic jams or public transport problems?
150.backbone: when从句(嵌套间接问句)+一般疑问句(should)
150.gloss: 问：估算路程时间要不要预留堵车等因素？
chunks: When we decide how much time we need to travel from one place to another,
should we always make allowances for the possibility of traffic jams or public transport problems?
150.rule: When 从句内嵌间接疑问句(how much/what...)描述场景，主句用 should we always + 动词 提问是否该有预防措施。
150.example: When we decide how much money we need for a trip, should we always leave some extra for unexpected expenses? — 估算旅行预算时，是否总该多留一些应急钱？

150.q: Do you find you often misjudge people when you meet them for the first time (for example, you might think they’re honest and they turn out to be dishonest)?
150.backbone: 一般疑问句+when从句+举例插入语(括号)
150.gloss: 问：初次见面常看错人吗？（举例说明）
chunks: Do you find you often misjudge people
when you meet them for the first time
(for example, you might think they’re honest and they turn out to be dishonest)?
150.rule: Do you find (that) + 从句 + when 从句限定情境，括号举例 you might think X and turn out Y 说明反差。
150.example: Do you find you often forget people’s names when you meet a lot of new people at once (for example, you might think you’ll remember and then completely blank)? — 一次认识很多人时常忘名字吗？(举例说明)

150.q: In what order do traffic lights turn from stop to go; that is, in what order do the colours change?
150.backbone: 特殊疑问句+同位语重述(that is)
150.gloss: 问：红绿灯变化顺序是怎样的？（换句话说）
chunks: In what order do traffic lights turn from stop to go;
that is,
in what order do the colours change?
150.rule: 先提出特殊疑问句，分号后用 that is, 再用更通俗的说法重述同一问题，帮助听者理解术语。
150.example: In what order do the seasons follow one another; that is, in what order does the weather change through the year? — 四季按什么顺序更替，也就是说一年中天气怎样按顺序变化？

151.q: If you faced south and could look at the horizon from where you’re sitting now, which village, town, city or country would be just beyond the horizon?
151.backbone: 第二条件句+特殊疑问句(which选项列举)
151.gloss: 问：若能望到地平线，地平线外是哪个地方？
chunks: If you faced south and could look at the horizon from where you’re sitting now,
which village, town, city or country would be just beyond the horizon?
151.rule: If + 过去式(可并列多个动作，含 where 从句)设想情境，主句 which A, B, C or D + would + 动词? 用并列名词列举选项提问。
151.example: If you climbed to the top of the highest hill near where you live now, which river, forest, valley or mountain would you be able to see? — 若爬上你家附近最高的山，能看到哪条河、哪片林、哪个谷或哪座山？

151.q: If someone borrowed a pullover of yours that was too small for them and they stretched it, would you be annoyed?
151.backbone: 第二条件句(含定语从句)+一般疑问句
151.gloss: 问：别人借穿你的毛衣把它撑大了，你会生气吗？
chunks: If someone borrowed a pullover of yours that was too small for them
and they stretched it,
would you be annoyed?
151.rule: If + 过去式设想情境(可含 that 定语从句修饰名词，并用 and 并列后续动作)，主句 would you be + 形容词? 询问情绪反应。
151.example: If someone used a mug of yours that had sentimental value and they chipped it, would you be upset? — 若有人用了你有纪念意义的杯子还把它磕坏了，你会难过吗？

151.q: Has anything ever happened to you which has been beyond your wildest dreams; that is, beyond your most fantastic expectations?
151.backbone: 现在完成时疑问句(含定语从句)+同位语重述
151.gloss: 问：有没有发生过超乎你想象的事？
chunks: Has anything ever happened to you which has been beyond your wildest dreams;
that is,
beyond your most fantastic expectations?
151.rule: Has anything ever happened to you which + 定语从句(现在完成时)? 分号后用 that is, 换一种说法重述定语从句的意思。
151.example: Has anyone ever said something to you which has stayed in your memory for years; that is, which you’ve never been able to forget? — 有没有人对你说过让你记很多年、始终忘不掉的话？

152.q: Why is it that, in a thunderstorm, we first see the flash of lightning, and then, after a delay of a few seconds, hear the thunder?
152.backbone: why疑问句+插入语+并列谓语(see...hear...)
152.gloss: 问：为何雷雨中先看到闪电后听到雷声？
chunks: Why is it that,
in a thunderstorm,
we first see the flash of lightning,
and then,
after a delay of a few seconds,
hear the thunder?
152.rule: Why is it that + 从句(可插入状语)，从句内用 first V1..., and then, [插入语], V2... 并列描述先后动作，追问原因。
152.example: Why is it that, in a heavy rainstorm, we first hear the crack of thunder, and then, a moment later, see the lightning flash? — 为何暴雨中我们先听到雷声，过一会儿才看到闪电？

152.q: If you heard a crashing sound outside your house in the middle of the night, would you get up and go out to see what had happened?
152.backbone: 第二条件句+一般疑问句+目的状语(过去完成)
152.gloss: 问：半夜听到撞击声，你会起来查看吗？
chunks: If you heard a crashing sound outside your house in the middle of the night,
would you get up and go out
to see what had happened?
152.rule: If + 过去式设想意外情况，主句 would you V1 and V2 + to see what had happened 表示为查明缘由采取的连续动作。
152.example: If you smelled smoke coming from your neighbour’s flat, would you knock on their door and ask what was going on? — 若闻到邻居家有烟味，你会去敲门问怎么回事吗？

152.q: Which verb do we use to describe the feeling that somebody wishes they could undo an action that they’ve done?
152.backbone: 特殊疑问句(which)+目的状语(含同位语从句)
152.gloss: 问：用哪个动词描述后悔已做之事的感觉？
chunks: Which verb do we use
to describe the feeling that somebody wishes they could undo an action that they’ve done?
152.rule: Which + 名词 + do we use to + 动词? 主句后接目的状语，内含 that 同位语从句具体描述该词表达的含义。
152.example: Which word do we use to describe the feeling that somebody has when they know something bad is about to happen? — 用哪个词描述预感到坏事将要发生的感觉？

153.q: When we’re using a comparative form, how can we communicate that the difference between two people or things is very big?
153.backbone: when从句+特殊疑问句(含宾语从句)
153.gloss: 问：用比较级时如何表达差异很大？
chunks: When we’re using a comparative form,
how can we communicate that the difference between two people or things is very big?
153.rule: When 从句交代语法背景，主句 how can we + 动词 + that 从句 询问如何用语言表达某种程度或含义。
153.example: When we’re using a superlative form, how can we communicate that something is the best by a huge margin? — 用最高级时，如何表达'遥遥领先'这种程度？

153.q: If you were a company boss, would you allow your employees to use their work computers to surf the internet?
153.backbone: 第二条件句+一般疑问句(是否允许)
153.gloss: 问：若你是老板，会允许员工上班上网吗？
chunks: If you were a company boss,
would you allow your employees to use their work computers to surf the internet?
153.rule: If + 过去式设想身份/角色，主句 would you allow sb to + 动词? 询问在该角色下是否会准许某行为。
153.example: If you were a school headteacher, would you allow students to use their phones during lunch breaks? — 若你是校长，会允许学生午休时用手机吗？

153.q: In road accidents, who or what do you think is to blame more than anything else?
153.backbone: 地点状语+特殊疑问句(含插入语do you think)
153.gloss: 问：交通事故中你认为什么最该负责？
chunks: In road accidents,
who or what do you think is to blame more than anything else?
153.rule: 场景状语开场，主句 who or what + do you think + 动词? 插入 do you think 询问看法并强调首要因素。
153.example: In workplace disputes, who or what do you think is at fault more than anything else? — 职场纠纷中，你觉得什么因素最该负责？

154.q: Give me an example of “anyway“ used in order to change the subject of a conversation, or return to a subject that was being talked about previously.
154.backbone: 祈使句：举例说明词语用法(目的状语)
154.gloss: 要求举例说明anyway用于转换/回归话题
chunks: Give me an example of “anyway“
used in order to change the subject of a conversation,
or return to a subject that was being talked about previously.
154.rule: 祈使句 Give me an example of [词/结构] used in order to V1, or V2..., 要求举例说明该词在两种并列用途下的用法。
154.example: Give me an example of “well” used in order to hesitate before answering, or to introduce a slightly surprising piece of news. — 举例说明well用于犹豫开口或引出略带意外的消息。

154.q: At a train station, how can we check what time a train is due to depart, and which platform it will depart from?
154.backbone: 地点状语+特殊疑问句(并列宾语从句)
154.gloss: 问：在车站如何查发车时间和站台？
chunks: At a train station,
how can we check what time a train is due to depart,
and which platform it will depart from?
154.rule: 地点状语开场，主句 how can we + 动词 + 并列两个间接疑问句(what.../which...) 询问获取信息的方式。
154.example: At an airport, how can we check what time a flight is due to land, and which gate it will arrive at? — 在机场，如何查到航班降落时间和到达的登机口？

154.q: What do we mean when we say “Beethoven and Tolstoy were both great men; the former was German, whereas the latter was Russian“?
154.backbone: 特殊疑问句+引语从句(the former/the latter对比)
154.gloss: 问：'前者……后者……'这句话是什么意思？
chunks: What do we mean
when we say “Beethoven and Tolstoy were both great men;
the former was German,
whereas the latter was Russian“?
154.rule: What do we mean when we say '...the former..., whereas the latter...'? 引用例句考查前者与后者对比结构的理解。
154.example: What do we mean when we say “Shakespeare and Mozart were both geniuses; the former was a writer, whereas the latter was a composer“? — 这句话中前者、后者分别指什么？

155.q: If you were on your way to a friend’s birthday party and it suddenly struck you that you’d forgotten their present, would you go back and get it or would you just go without it?
155.backbone: 第二条件句(并列)+选择疑问句
155.gloss: 问：去派对路上想起忘带礼物，回去拿还是算了？
chunks: If you were on your way to a friend’s birthday party
and it suddenly struck you that you’d forgotten their present,
would you go back and get it
or would you just go without it?
155.rule: If + 过去式并列描述情境(可含 it struck you that 从句表突然意识到)，主句用 would you A or would you B? 对比两种应对方式。
155.example: If you were halfway through a long journey and it suddenly struck you that you’d left the door unlocked, would you turn back and check or would you just carry on? — 半路突然想起没锁门，是折返检查还是继续走？

155.q: During an evening out with friends, would you have to take somebody aside from the rest of the group if you wanted to speak to them in private?
155.backbone: 时间状语+一般疑问句+条件从句(后置if)
155.gloss: 问：和朋友聚会时，私下说话要把人拉到一边吗？
chunks: During an evening out with friends,
would you have to take somebody aside from the rest of the group
if you wanted to speak to them in private?
155.rule: 场景状语开场，主句 would you have to + 动词，句末用 if 从句补充说明触发该行为的条件(条件从句后置)。
155.example: During a busy family dinner, would you have to leave the table if you wanted to make a private phone call? — 家庭聚餐时，想打私人电话是不是得离席？

155.q: If you heard a curious noise outside your room in the middle of the night, would you stay in bed or go and investigate?
155.backbone: 第二条件句+选择疑问句
155.gloss: 问：半夜听到怪声，你会躺着还是去查看？
chunks: If you heard a curious noise outside your room in the middle of the night,
would you stay in bed
or go and investigate?
155.rule: If + 过去式设想意外情境，主句 would you A or (would you) V2? 用两个并列动词对比两种反应。
155.example: If you saw a strange light in the sky at night, would you ignore it or go outside to take a closer look? — 若夜里看到天上有怪异亮光，你会不理会还是出去细看？

156.q: If you suddenly do a lot of physical exercise after a long period of not having done any exercise at all, do your muscles feel stiff the next day?
156.backbone: 真实条件句+一般疑问句(结果)
156.gloss: 问：久不运动突然大量运动，次日肌肉会酸吗？
chunks: If you suddenly do a lot of physical exercise after a long period of not having done any exercise at all,
do your muscles feel stiff the next day?
156.rule: If + 现在时(可加 after 状语，内含 not having done 完成式否定动名词)描述真实情况，主句 do + 主语 + 动词? 询问随之而来的结果。
156.example: If you suddenly eat a lot of spicy food after a long period of eating only bland meals, does your stomach feel upset the next day? — 长期吃清淡后突然吃很多辣的，隔天肠胃会不舒服吗？

156.q: When you go to stay at someone else’s house, do you take your own toothpaste with you, or do you ask to use their toothpaste?
156.gloss: 问：住别人家时自带牙膏还是借用？
chunks: When you go to stay at someone else’s house,
do you take your own toothpaste with you,
or do you ask to use their toothpaste?
156.rule: When 从句设定场景，主句用 do you A, or do you B? 并列两个完整疑问句对比两种做法。
156.example: When you go camping in the countryside, do you bring your own drinking water with you, or do you rely on finding a local source? — 去乡下露营时，是自带饮用水还是就地找水源？

156.q: What’s a wasp likely to do if it lands on you while you’re sunbathing and you disturb it?
156.backbone: 特殊疑问句+条件从句(含时间状语从句)
156.gloss: 问：黄蜂落你身上又被惊扰，它可能会做什么？
chunks: What’s a wasp likely to do
if it lands on you while you’re sunbathing
and you disturb it?
156.rule: What's + 主语 + likely to do? 后接 if 从句(可内嵌 while 从句和并列动作)描述触发该行为的具体情境。
156.example: What’s a dog likely to do if a stranger comes near its owner while it’s sleeping and it wakes up suddenly? — 陌生人靠近主人时狗正睡着突然惊醒，它可能会做什么？

157.q: If you wanted to do a 500-piece jigsaw puzzle, would you need a big table to spread out all the pieces on?
157.backbone: 第二条件句+一般疑问句
157.gloss: 问：拼500片拼图需要大桌子摆开吗？
chunks: If you wanted to do a 500-piece jigsaw puzzle,
would you need a big table to spread out all the pieces on?
157.rule: If + 过去式设想活动，主句 would you need + 名词 + to + 动词(目的状语，介词可悬挂句末) 询问所需条件。
157.example: If you wanted to repaint your whole living room, would you need to move all the furniture out to give yourself space to work in? — 若想重新粉刷客厅，是不是得把家具都搬出去腾空间？

157.q: What usually happens to that area of the body where a bee or some other insect has stung us?
157.gloss: 问：被蜂或虫叮咬的部位通常会怎样？
chunks: What usually happens to that area of the body
where a bee or some other insect has stung us?
157.rule: What usually happens to + 名词 + where 定语从句(现在完成时)? 用 where 引导定语从句具体说明该名词所指的位置。
157.example: What usually happens to that patch of skin where the sun has burned us badly? — 被太阳严重晒伤的那块皮肤通常会怎样？

157.q: If you attempted to learn another language at the same time as English, do you think you’d get confused?
157.backbone: 第二条件句+一般疑问句(含插入语do you think)
157.gloss: 问：同时学另一种语言和英语会混淆吗？
chunks: If you attempted to learn another language at the same time as English,
do you think you’d get confused?
157.rule: If + 过去式设想情境，主句用 do you think + 陈述句(you'd...) 插入 do you think 委婉询问对方的预判。
157.example: If you tried to cook three different dishes at the same time, do you think you’d end up burning one of them? — 若同时做三道菜，你觉得会不会有一道被烧糊？

158.q: In a restaurant, if the food has been cooked well but is simply not to your taste, do you call the waiter and complain, or do you just eat what you’ve been given?
158.backbone: 地点状语+条件从句+选择疑问句
158.gloss: 问：餐厅里菜合格但不合口味，投诉还是照吃？
chunks: In a restaurant,
if the food has been cooked well but is simply not to your taste,
do you call the waiter and complain,
or do you just eat what you’ve been given?
158.rule: 场景状语+if 从句(现在完成时，可用 but 转折)设情境，主句 do you A, or do you just V what 从句? 对比主动应对与被动接受。
158.example: In a shop, if the item has been priced clearly but turns out to be faulty when you get home, do you go back and demand a refund, or do you just keep what you’ve bought? — 商品标价清楚但回家发现有瑕疵，你会回去退款还是将就留着？

158.q: Give me an example of a mixed conditional where we imagine a situation in the past and then imagine the consequence of that in the present, please.
158.backbone: 祈使句：举例混合虚拟条件句(过去因→现在果)
158.gloss: 要求举例：过去情况导致现在结果的混合条件句
chunks: Give me an example of a mixed conditional
where we imagine a situation in the past
and then imagine the consequence of that in the present, please.
158.rule: 祈使句 Give me an example of a mixed conditional where...in [时间1] and then...in [时间2]，要求举例因果混合虚拟句。
158.example: Give me an example of a mixed conditional where we imagine a different choice in the past and then imagine how our lifestyle would be different now, please. — 举例：过去若做了不同选择，现在生活会如何不同的混合虚拟句。

158.q: Give me an example of a mixed conditional where we imagine a situation in the present and then imagine the consequence of that in the past, please.
158.backbone: 祈使句：举例混合虚拟条件句(现在因→过去果)
158.gloss: 要求举例：现在情况导致过去结果的混合条件句
chunks: Give me an example of a mixed conditional
where we imagine a situation in the present
and then imagine the consequence of that in the past, please.
158.rule: 祈使句 Give me an example of a mixed conditional where...in [时间1] and then...in [时间2]，此处对调为现在因、过去果。
158.example: Give me an example of a mixed conditional where we imagine a different personality trait in the present and then imagine how we would have acted differently in the past, please. — 举例：现在若性格不同，过去会有何不同举动的混合虚拟句。

159.q: Now, I will name an activity, and I want you to tell me how long it is since you last did it. Swim in the sea
159.backbone: 指令句+活动提示：since句型问'多久没做'
159.gloss: 说明规则后给出活动：上次游泳是多久前
chunks: Now, I will name an activity,
and I want you to tell me how long it is since you last did it.
Swim in the sea
159.rule: 指令模板：I will name an activity, tell me how long it is since you last did it. 后接活动短语，用 since 句型作答。
159.example: Now, I will name an activity, and I want you to tell me how long it is since you last did it. Ride a bicycle — 说明规则后给出活动：上次骑自行车是多久前。

159.q: If you were a sales assistant in a large department store, which department would you most enjoy working in?
159.backbone: 第二条件句+特殊疑问句(which)
159.gloss: 问：若在百货公司当店员，最想在哪个部门？
chunks: If you were a sales assistant in a large department store,
which department would you most enjoy working in?
159.rule: If + 过去式设想职业身份，主句 which + 名词 + would you most enjoy V-ing? 介词悬挂句末，询问该身份下的偏好。
159.example: If you were a chef in a five-star hotel, which type of cuisine would you most enjoy specializing in? — 若你是五星酒店的厨师，最想专攻哪种菜系？

159.q: Would you agree that, in general, a person’s shyness diminishes as they become more mature?
159.backbone: 一般疑问句(含宾语从句+as比较状语)
159.gloss: 问：你同意人越成熟越不害羞吗？
chunks: Would you agree that,
in general,
a person’s shyness diminishes as they become more mature?
159.rule: Would you agree that, [插入语如 in general], + 从句(可含 as 引导的伴随比较状语)? 委婉征询对方是否认同某观点。
159.example: Would you agree that, on the whole, a person’s confidence grows as they gain more experience? — 你是否同意，人的自信总体上会随经验增长而提升？

160.q: When a person of average size goes shopping, are they more likely to find clothes their size in stock than an exceptionally big or small person?
160.backbone: when从句+一般疑问句(比较级than)
160.gloss: 问：普通身材的人比特殊身材更容易买到合身衣服吗？
chunks: When a person of average size goes shopping,
are they more likely to find clothes their size in stock
than an exceptionally big or small person?
160.rule: When 从句设定主体情境，主句用 are/is + 主语 + more likely to + 动词 + than + 对比对象? 比较两类人的可能性差异。
160.example: When a person with average-sized feet buys shoes, are they more likely to find their size in stock than someone with unusually large or small feet? — 脚码普通的人比脚特别大或小的人更容易买到合脚的鞋吗？

160.q: If you saw a child walking towards a beach with a bucket and spade in their hand, what would you think they were going to do?
160.backbone: 第二条件句+特殊疑问句(嵌套宾语从句)
160.gloss: 问：看到孩子拿桶铲走向海滩，会猜他要做什么？
chunks: If you saw a child walking towards a beach with a bucket and spade in their hand,
what would you think they were going to do?
160.rule: If + 过去式(常含现在分词短语描述所见画面)设想目击场景，主句 what would you think + 从句(过去进行时) 推测对方接下来的行为。
160.example: If you saw a man running towards a bus stop with a suitcase in his hand, what would you think he was trying to do? — 看到有人拎着行李箱跑向公交站，会猜他要做什么？

160.q: If you went to the doctor complaining of a cough, which part of your body would the doctor examine?
160.backbone: 第二条件句+特殊疑问句(which)
160.gloss: 问：因咳嗽看医生，医生会检查哪个部位？
chunks: If you went to the doctor complaining of a cough,
which part of your body would the doctor examine?
160.rule: If + 过去式(常含现在分词短语 complaining of 说明理由)设想就医情境，主句 which + 名词 + would + 主语 + 动词? 询问对应的具体对象。
160.example: If you went to the dentist complaining of tooth pain, which tooth would the dentist most likely examine first? — 因牙痛去看牙医，牙医最可能先检查哪颗牙？

161.q: Do you believe that every piece of furniture in a house should have a use, or do you believe that certain pieces can be purely ornamental?
161.backbone: 选择疑问句：should引导宾语从句 or 并列另一从句
161.gloss: 你认为家具都该有用途，还是有些纯粹装饰？
chunks: Do you believe that every piece of furniture in a house should have a use,
or do you believe that certain pieces can be purely ornamental?
161.rule: 公式：Do you believe that+从句A, or do you believe that+从句B? 用两个并列that宾语从句表达两种对立观点
161.example: Do you think that all students should learn a second language, or do you think that it should be optional? — 你认为所有学生都该学第二语言，还是应该可选？

161.q: If you arrived at an airport and discovered that your flight was delayed for five hours, what would you do in the meantime?
161.backbone: 过去式虚拟条件句 + 特殊疑问句
161.gloss: 如果你在机场发现航班延误五小时，你会怎么办？
chunks: If you arrived at an airport
and discovered that your flight was delayed for five hours,
what would you do in the meantime?
161.rule: 公式：If+过去式虚拟条件(可嵌套that宾语从句), 特殊疑问词+would you+动词原形，虚拟情境下推测提问
161.example: If you went to a restaurant and found that your reservation had been cancelled, what would you say to the staff? — 如果你去餐厅发现预订被取消，你会对店员说什么？

161.q: If you spent a delightful time on holiday somewhere, would you consider going back to the same place the following year?
161.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + would consider doing
161.gloss: 如果假期玩得很开心，你会考虑明年再去吗？
chunks: If you spent a delightful time on holiday somewhere,
would you consider going back to the same place the following year?
161.rule: 公式：If+过去式虚拟条件从句, would you consider+动名词...? 用consider doing表达对虚拟情境的意愿
161.example: If you met a famous author at a party, would you consider asking them for advice? — 如果在聚会上遇到知名作家，你会考虑向他们请教吗？

162.q: If a friend of yours said that they were thinking about travelling around the world alone for a year, would you encourage them to do it or discourage them from doing it?
162.backbone: 虚拟条件句(含that宾语从句) + 选择疑问
162.gloss: 如果朋友想独自环游世界一年，你会鼓励还是劝阻？
chunks: If a friend of yours said that they were thinking about travelling around the world alone for a year,
would you encourage them to do it
or discourage them from doing it?
162.rule: 公式：If+主语+said that+从句(嵌套宾语从句), would you+动词A or+动词B? 虚拟条件套间接引语再接选择疑问
162.example: If a colleague of yours said that they were thinking about quitting their job, would you support them or try to talk them out of it? — 如果同事说想辞职，你会支持还是劝阻？

162.q: Do you think that admission to museums, art galleries etc. ought to be free and that the government should pay to maintain such places?
162.backbone: think that…and that…并列宾语从句
162.gloss: 你认为博物馆美术馆该免费，政府该出钱维护吗？
chunks: Do you think that admission to museums, art galleries etc. ought to be free
and that the government should pay to maintain such places?
162.rule: 公式：Do you think that+从句A and that+从句B? 用and that重复连接词引出第二个并列宾语从句
162.example: Do you think that public transport should be cheaper and that cities should build more cycle lanes? — 你认为公共交通该更便宜、城市该多建自行车道吗？

162.q: When you visit a place of historic interest, do you prefer to be shown around by a guide?
162.backbone: when时间状语从句 + 一般疑问句
162.gloss: 参观古迹时，你喜欢有导游带你参观吗？
chunks: When you visit a place of historic interest,
do you prefer to be shown around by a guide?
162.rule: 公式：When+现在时状语从句, do/would you+动词...? when从句设定情境，接一般疑问句问习惯或偏好
162.example: When you cook a meal for guests, do you prefer to follow a recipe exactly? — 给客人做饭时，你喜欢严格照食谱做吗？

163.q: When telling stories about things that have happened to them, do some people exaggerate in order to make the stories more interesting?
163.backbone: when+分词状语 + in order to目的状语
163.gloss: 讲自己的经历时，有人会为了有趣而夸张吗？
chunks: When telling stories about things that have happened to them,
do some people exaggerate
in order to make the stories more interesting?
163.rule: 公式：When+现在分词状语(可含定语从句), do主语+动词... in order to+目的? 分词状语设情境，接疑问句+目的状语
163.example: When answering questions in an interview, do candidates sometimes exaggerate their achievements in order to impress the interviewer? — 面试答题时，应聘者有时会为了给面试官留下印象而夸大成就吗？

163.q: Are you the type of person who squeezes a tube of toothpaste in the middle, or do you always squeeze it at the end?
163.backbone: who定语从句 + or选择疑问句
163.gloss: 你是从中间挤牙膏，还是总从末端挤？
chunks: Are you the type of person who squeezes a tube of toothpaste in the middle,
or do you always squeeze it at the end?
163.rule: 公式：Are you the type of person who+动词从句, or do you always+动词...? who定语从句描述习惯类型，or引出对立选项
163.example: Are you the type of person who reads the last page of a book first, or do you always wait until the end? — 你是那种先看书结尾的人，还是总等到最后才看？

163.q: When you attend an event like a theatre performance or a football match, do you buy a programme and keep it as a souvenir?
163.backbone: when时间状语从句 + 一般疑问句
163.gloss: 看演出或比赛时，你会买场刊留作纪念吗？
chunks: When you attend an event like a theatre performance or a football match,
do you buy a programme
and keep it as a souvenir?
163.rule: 公式：When+状语从句, do you+动词A and+动词B? when设定场景，主句用and并列两个动作构成一般疑问句
163.example: When you finish reading a good novel, do you recommend it to friends and write a short review? — 读完一本好小说后，你会推荐给朋友并写篇短评吗？

164.q: If you were planning to see a film with a friend who lived close to the cinema, would you arrange to call for them on the way to the cinema or meet them there?
164.backbone: 虚拟条件句(嵌套who定语从句) + 选择疑问
164.gloss: 如果和住影院附近的朋友看电影，你会顺路叫上他还是直接约在那见？
chunks: If you were planning to see a film with a friend who lived close to the cinema,
would you arrange to call for them on the way to the cinema
or meet them there?
164.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句(嵌套who定语从句修饰宾语), would you+动词A or+动词B? 定语从句补充人物，主句选择疑问
164.example: If you were going hiking with a friend who had never done it before, would you choose an easy trail or a challenging one? — 如果和从没爬过山的朋友去徒步，你会选简单路线还是有挑战的？

164.q: If you had a train to catch from the nearest station in ten minutes’ time, do you reckon you could make it if you left right now?
164.backbone: 条件句 + 嵌套if条件宾语从句
164.gloss: 如果十分钟后要赶火车，你觉得现在出发能赶上吗？
chunks: If you had a train to catch from the nearest station in ten minutes’ time,
do you reckon you could make it
if you left right now?
164.rule: 公式：If+条件从句1, do you reckon+宾语从句(内嵌if条件从句2)? 主句疑问内部再套一层if条件，双层假设
164.example: If you had a flight to catch in twenty minutes, do you reckon you could make it if you ran the whole way? — 如果二十分钟后要赶飞机，你觉得一路跑能赶上吗？

164.q: Why do you think lottery tickets sell in such large numbers in spite of the fact that the odds of winning are so incredibly small?
164.backbone: why特殊疑问 + in spite of the fact that让步状语
164.gloss: 为什么中奖概率这么小，彩票还卖得那么好？
chunks: Why do you think lottery tickets sell in such large numbers
in spite of the fact that the odds of winning are so incredibly small?
164.rule: 公式：Why do you think+宾语从句 in spite of the fact that+让步从句? 用in spite of the fact that引出与主句相悖的事实
164.example: Why do you think people still smoke in spite of the fact that the health risks are so well known? — 为什么明知健康风险这么大，还是有人吸烟？

165.q: If somebody is sentenced to a certain period of time in prison, do you agree they should be released early for good behaviour?
165.backbone: 一般条件句 + agree宾语从句(省略that)
165.gloss: 如果有人被判刑，你同意表现好可以提前释放吗？
chunks: If somebody is sentenced to a certain period of time in prison,
do you agree they should be released early for good behaviour?
165.rule: 公式：If+一般条件从句(一般现在时), do you agree (that)+宾语从句(可省that)? 一般条件设情境，agree接省略连词的从句
165.example: If someone breaks a promise, do you agree they should apologize immediately? — 如果有人违背承诺，你同意他该立刻道歉吗？

165.q: If you had a nasty cold one weekend and didn’t feel up to going out, what would you do instead?
165.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + 特殊疑问句
165.gloss: 如果周末重感冒不想出门，你会做什么？
chunks: If you had a nasty cold one weekend
and didn’t feel up to going out,
what would you do instead?
165.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句(and并列第二动作), what would you+动词+instead? instead强调虚拟情境下的替代做法
165.example: If you had a headache one evening and didn’t feel like cooking, what would you do instead? — 如果晚上头疼不想做饭，你会做什么代替？

165.q: By learning the language of a country, do you think one automatically acquires some knowledge of that country’s culture?
165.backbone: by doing方式状语 + think宾语从句
165.gloss: 学一国语言，你觉得就能自然了解它的文化吗？
chunks: By learning the language of a country,
do you think one automatically acquires some knowledge of that country’s culture?
165.rule: 公式：By+动名词短语(方式状语)置句首, do you think+宾语从句? 用by doing表示手段，引出think引导的疑问
165.example: By living abroad for a year, do you think one automatically becomes fluent in the local language? — 在国外生活一年，你觉得就能自然说流利当地语言吗？

166.q: When we create a piece of writing, like a letter or an essay for example, how can we ensure that we’ve included all the information we need to, and that our information is clearly organized?
166.backbone: when状语从句 + how疑问+并列that宾语从句
166.gloss: 写文章时，怎样确保信息齐全且条理清晰？
chunks: When we create a piece of writing, like a letter or an essay for example,
how can we ensure that we’ve included all the information we need to,
and that our information is clearly organized?
166.rule: 公式：When+状语从句(含举例插入语), how can we ensure that+从句A, and that+从句B? how疑问接ensure双重that从句
166.example: When we plan a trip abroad, like a long holiday for example, how can we make sure that we’ve booked everything we need to, and that our budget is realistic? — 计划出国旅行时，怎样确保该订的都订好、预算也现实？

166.q: If you were a teacher and saw one of your students gazing out of the window during a lesson, would you assume they were not paying attention?
166.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + assume宾语从句
166.gloss: 如果你是老师，看到学生望窗外，你会认为他走神吗？
chunks: If you were a teacher
and saw one of your students gazing out of the window during a lesson,
would you assume they were not paying attention?
166.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句(and并列第二动作), would you assume (that)+宾语从句? 虚拟身份加目睹情境，assume引出推测
166.example: If you were a manager and saw an employee arriving late every day, would you assume they weren’t taking the job seriously? — 如果你是经理，看到员工天天迟到，你会认为他不认真工作吗？

166.q: Do you like to be surprised by friends dropping in (dropping by) for a chat, or do you prefer them to give you a ring to let you know they’re coming?
166.gloss: 你喜欢朋友突然来访，还是希望他们先打电话通知？
chunks: Do you like to be surprised by friends dropping in (dropping by) for a chat,
or do you prefer them to give you a ring
to let you know they’re coming?
166.rule: 公式：Do you like to be+过去分词(被动) by..., or do you prefer them to+动词...? 被动式与prefer sb to do对比选择
166.example: Do you like to be woken up by an alarm, or do you prefer your body to wake you naturally? — 你喜欢被闹钟叫醒，还是希望身体自然醒？

167.q: If a gang of young men were making a racket outside your house in the middle of the night, would you call the police, go out and talk to them, or just try to ignore the racket?
167.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + 三项并列选择疑问
167.gloss: 如果深夜有人在你家外喧闹，你会报警、出去理论还是不理？
chunks: If a gang of young men were making a racket outside your house in the middle of the night,
would you call the police,
go out and talk to them,
or just try to ignore the racket?
167.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句, would you+动词A, +动词B, or just+动词C? 虚拟条件后接三项并列供选择的疑问句
167.example: If your neighbours were having a loud party late at night, would you knock on their door, call the landlord, or just try to sleep through it? — 如果邻居深夜开吵闹派对，你会敲门理论、找房东还是硬睡过去？

167.q: And now, make the following sentences more emphatic by using an inversion, please: I had barely sat down when the cat jumped onto my lap
167.backbone: 祈使句指令 + 待转换的倒装例句
167.gloss: 请用倒装使句子更强调：我刚坐下猫就跳上腿
chunks: And now, make the following sentences more emphatic by using an inversion, please:
I had barely sat down
when the cat jumped onto my lap
167.rule: 公式：Make the sentence more emphatic by using an inversion: 把barely/no sooner等否定副词提前，主谓部分倒装
167.example: Make the following sentence more emphatic by using an inversion, please: I had no sooner opened the door than the dog ran out — 请用倒装使这句更强调：我刚开门狗就跑出去了

167.q: How do you feel when you go to buy something you’ve really been looking forward to getting and discover that the shop has sold out?
167.backbone: how特殊疑问 + when时间状语(含定语从句)
167.gloss: 满心期待去买东西却发现卖光了，你什么感受？
chunks: How do you feel
when you go to buy something you’ve really been looking forward to getting
and discover that the shop has sold out?
167.rule: 公式：How do you feel when+状语从句(含定语从句, and并列discover宾语从句)? when从句层层修饰后并列一个新动作
167.example: How do you feel when you finally get the ticket you’ve been waiting weeks for and discover that the seat is right at the back? — 苦等几周终于买到票却发现座位在最后一排，你什么感受？

168.q: If an author you liked a lot wrote a story so long that it had to be published in two or even three volumes, would that put you off reading it?
168.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + so…that结果状语从句
168.gloss: 如果喜欢的作家写的书长到要分两三卷，你会因此不想读吗？
chunks: If an author you liked a lot wrote a story so long
that it had to be published in two or even three volumes,
would that put you off reading it?
168.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句(内含so...that结果状语从句), would that+动词...? so...that表结果，主句用that指代该情境提问
168.example: If a film was so slow that nothing happened for the first hour, would that put you off watching it to the end? — 如果一部电影慢到开头一小时啥都没发生，你会因此不想看完吗？

168.q: If you had called to reserve a table at a restaurant but then discovered on arriving that there was no record of the booking, what would you expect to happen?
168.backbone: 过去完成虚拟条件句 + 特殊疑问句
168.gloss: 如果订了位到店却发现没记录，你觉得该怎么处理？
chunks: If you had called to reserve a table at a restaurant
but then discovered on arriving that there was no record of the booking,
what would you expect to happen?
168.rule: 公式：If+过去完成虚拟条件从句(but引出on doing that嵌套的意外发现), what would you expect to happen? 表已然动作后转折
168.example: If you had booked a hotel room online but discovered on checking in that there was no record of it, what would you expect the staff to do? — 如果网上订了酒店房间却发现登记时没记录，你觉得工作人员该怎么处理？

168.q: If you heard a gun go off in the street and then saw the gunman running past you, would you go after him?
168.backbone: 虚拟条件句(感官动词+原形) + would疑问
168.gloss: 如果听到街上枪响并看到枪手跑过，你会追上去吗？
chunks: If you heard a gun go off in the street
and then saw the gunman running past you,
would you go after him?
168.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句(heard/saw+宾语+原形/现在分词, and then并列), would you+动词...? 感官动词接宾语补足语
168.example: If you heard glass smash next door and then saw a stranger climbing over the fence, would you call the police? — 如果听到隔壁玻璃碎了又看到陌生人翻墙，你会报警吗？

169.q: If you wanted maximum security for your money, would you rather set up a pension, invest in the stock market, or save the money in a bank account?
169.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + would rather三项并列选择
169.gloss: 为了资金最安全，你会选养老金、股市还是银行存款？
chunks: If you wanted maximum security for your money,
would you rather set up a pension,
invest in the stock market,
or save the money in a bank account?
169.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句, would you rather+动词A, +动词B, or+动词C? would rather接三个并列动词原形表选择
169.example: If you wanted to relax completely, would you rather go to the beach, stay home and read, or book a spa day? — 为了彻底放松，你会选择去海滩、在家看书还是做水疗？

169.q: If you visited India, would it be reasonable to assume that, before long, you’d catch a glimpse of a tiger?
169.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + it be reasonable to assume that插入语
169.gloss: 如果去印度，是否有理由认为你不久就能瞥见老虎？
chunks: If you visited India,
would it be reasonable to assume that,
before long,
you’d catch a glimpse of a tiger?
169.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句, would it be reasonable to assume that, +插入语, +从句? 形式主语结构中间插入状语
169.example: If you moved to a small village, would it be reasonable to assume that, over time, you’d know most of your neighbours? — 如果搬到小村庄，是否有理由认为久了你会认识大多数邻居？

169.q: Why do some people buy products, especially technological products, as soon as they’re launched rather than wait a while for prices to come down?
169.backbone: why疑问 + as soon as时间状语 + rather than对比
169.gloss: 为什么有人产品一上市就买，而不等降价？
chunks: Why do some people buy products, especially technological products,
as soon as they’re launched
rather than wait a while for prices to come down?
169.rule: 公式：Why do some people+动词..., as soon as+时间从句 rather than+动词原形...? rather than接动词原形对比替代做法
169.example: Why do some people book flights, especially international ones, as soon as tickets go on sale rather than wait for a possible discount? — 为什么有人机票一开售就买，尤其是国际航班，而不等可能的折扣？

170.q: If a friend of yours, who you knew was a dreadful driver, offered to give you a lift, what would you do?
170.backbone: 条件句嵌入插入定语从句 + 特殊疑问
170.gloss: 如果一位你知道车技很差的朋友要载你，你会怎么办？
chunks: If a friend of yours,
who you knew was a dreadful driver,
offered to give you a lift,
what would you do?
170.rule: 公式：If+主语,+插入who定语从句(修饰主语),+谓语, what would you do? 定语从句插入主谓之间补充说明该人物
170.example: If a colleague of yours, who you knew was often late, asked you to cover for them, what would you do? — 如果一位你知道常迟到的同事让你帮忙打掩护，你会怎么办？

170.q: When a manager gives an employee feedback on their performance at work, do you think they should always speak frankly or should they take into account the worker’s character?
170.backbone: when状语从句 + 选择疑问(think…or should…)
170.gloss: 经理给员工反馈时，该总是直言还是考虑员工性格？
chunks: When a manager gives an employee feedback on their performance at work,
do you think they should always speak frankly
or should they take into account the worker’s character?
170.rule: 公式：When+状语从句, do you think+主语+should+动词A or should+主语+动词B? think后接选择疑问式宾语从句
170.example: When a doctor delivers bad news to a patient, do you think they should be completely direct or should they soften the message? — 医生告诉病人坏消息时，该完全直接还是该委婉一些？

170.q: If you weren’t enjoying a play at the theatre, why would it be more appropriate to leave during an interval than during the performance itself?
170.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + why疑问+比较结构more…than
170.gloss: 如果不喜欢一场戏，为什么中场离开比演出中离开更合适？
chunks: If you weren’t enjoying a play at the theatre,
why would it be more appropriate to leave during an interval
than during the performance itself?
170.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句, why would it be more appropriate to A than B? more...than比较结构接理由疑问
170.example: If you weren’t enjoying a meal at a friend’s house, why would it be more polite to finish it than to leave food on your plate? — 如果不喜欢朋友家做的饭，为什么吃完比剩菜更礼貌？

171.q: If you’d finished using a barbecue but the fire was still glowing, would you put it out with water, for example, or wait for it to go out on its own?
171.backbone: 虚拟条件句(完成时+过去式并列) + 选择疑问
171.gloss: 如果烧烤用完但余火未熄，你会浇水灭火还是让它自灭？
chunks: If you’d finished using a barbecue
but the fire was still glowing,
would you put it out with water, for example,
or wait for it to go out on its own?
171.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句(完成时+but并列过去式从句), would you+动词A, for example, or+动词B? but连接两个并列条件
171.example: If you’d finished charging your phone but the cable was still plugged in, would you unplug it straight away, for example, or just leave it? — 如果手机充完电但线还插着，你会马上拔掉还是就这么放着？

171.q: When writing an application letter or email to someone called “David Jones”, for example, how should we start the letter: “Dear David”, “Dear David Jones” or “Dear Mr Jones”?
171.backbone: when分词状语 + how疑问+并列选项列举
171.gloss: 写申请信给David Jones时，开头该怎么称呼？
chunks: When writing an application letter or email to someone called “David Jones”, for example,
how should we start the letter:
“Dear David”, “Dear David Jones” or “Dear Mr Jones”?
171.rule: 公式：When+现在分词状语(含举例插入语), how should we+动词: 列举具体选项? 分词状语设情境后直接列出候选答案
171.example: When replying to an email from someone called “Sarah Lee”, for example, how should we start: “Hi Sarah”, “Dear Sarah Lee” or “Dear Ms Lee”? — 回复一封来自Sarah Lee的邮件时，开头该怎么写？

171.q: If a boxer manages to knock his opponent down easily in both the first and second round, can he reasonably expect to be able to knock him out fairly soon after?
171.backbone: 一般条件句 + can情态疑问+不定式嵌套
171.gloss: 如果拳手一二回合都轻松击倒对手，能预期很快将其KO吗？
chunks: If a boxer manages to knock his opponent down easily in both the first and second round,
can he reasonably expect to be able to knock him out fairly soon after?
171.rule: 公式：If+一般条件从句(manage to do表已成功动作), can+主语+reasonably expect to be able to+动词? 双重不定式嵌套
171.example: If a student manages to pass the first two exams easily, can they reasonably expect to be able to pass the final one as well? — 如果学生轻松通过前两场考试，能合理预期也能通过最后一场吗？

172.q: If you spotted a tiny stain on the front of a friend’s wedding dress a few hours before the ceremony itself, would you bring the matter up or just keep quiet?
172.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + 选择疑问(bring up or keep quiet)
172.gloss: 如果婚礼前发现婚纱上有污渍，你会说出来还是不吭声？
chunks: If you spotted a tiny stain on the front of a friend’s wedding dress a few hours before the ceremony itself,
would you bring the matter up
or just keep quiet?
172.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句, would you+动词A or just+动词B? 虚拟条件后接两项对立选择，just强调消极选项
172.example: If you noticed a small crack in a friend’s phone screen while borrowing it, would you mention it or just keep quiet? — 如果借朋友手机时发现屏幕有裂痕，你会说出来还是不吭声？

172.q: If you were watching a procession in the street and a policeman told you to get back, what would he want you to do and why?
172.backbone: 虚拟条件句 + 双重特殊疑问(what…and why)
172.gloss: 如果警察让你在游行中后退，他要你做什么、为什么？
chunks: If you were watching a procession in the street
and a policeman told you to get back,
what would he want you to do and why?
172.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句(and并列第二从句), what would+人物+want you to do and why? what...and why双重疑问收尾
172.example: If you were queuing at a shop and a staff member told you to move aside, what would they want you to do and why? — 如果你在商店排队，店员让你让开，他要你做什么、为什么？

172.q: When you’re on your way to meet someone but only have a vague idea of where you’re going, what do you do?
172.backbone: when状语从句(but转折+间接疑问) + 特殊疑问
172.gloss: 去见人的路上如果不太确定方向，你会怎么做？
chunks: When you’re on your way to meet someone
but only have a vague idea of where you’re going,
what do you do?
172.rule: 公式：When+状语从句(but转折引出含where间接疑问的让步小句), what do you do? 用but引出转折限定条件
172.example: When you’re trying to fix something but only have a vague idea of how it works, what do you do? — 修理东西时如果不太清楚原理，你会怎么做？

173.q: If a ten-year-old boy revealed to you that a bully was picking on him at school, would you advise him to stand up for himself or tell him to report the bully to a teacher?
173.backbone: 虚拟条件句(含that宾语从句) + 选择疑问
173.gloss: 如果十岁男孩说被欺负，你会让他自己反抗还是报告老师？
chunks: If a ten-year-old boy revealed to you that a bully was picking on him at school,
would you advise him to stand up for himself
or tell him to report the bully to a teacher?

173.q: If you were on an excursion to see the remains of an ancient castle and you spotted another tourist dropping litter on the site, what would you do?

what would you do?
173.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句(and并列第二从句共同构成情境), what would you do? 两个并列小句叠加铺垫背景
173.example: If you were on a tour to see a famous museum and you noticed another visitor touching the exhibits, what would you do? — 如果参观名馆时看到游客触摸展品，你会怎么做？

173.q: When giving someone feedback concerning their performance at work, why is it a good idea for a manager to conclude with a positive remark?

why is it a good idea for a manager to conclude with a positive remark?

174.q: If you were engaged part-time by a company and found that you really enjoyed the role, how long would you wait before asking about the possibility of a full-time position, or would you never ask?

which features of the area would you focus on in advertisements?
174.rule: 公式：If+虚拟条件从句, which+名词短语+would you+动词...? which引导疑问询问具体选项，前置作宾语
174.example: If you were in charge of redesigning this app, which features would you improve first? — 如果你负责重新设计这个应用，你会先改进哪些功能？

chunks: If you knew that a family member was deliberately not paying their income tax,

175.q: If you had to wait ages for your order to be taken in a restaurant but then the food itself turned out to be delicious, would you leave a tip?
175.backbone: 虚拟条件句(but转折) + 一般疑问
175.gloss: 如果点餐等很久但菜很好吃，你会留小费吗？

chunks: If you fold a piece of paper in half twice,

how many pieces of paper do you end up with?

177.q: When a company needs to reduce its workforce in order to stay in business, is it very hard to decide who to make redundant and who to keep on?

who do you turn to?

how much would you pay?
